  md.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  COALESCE(
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.language LIKE '%english%' AND LOWER(s.synonym) LIKE '%epoetin%' THEN s.synonym END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.language LIKE '%english%' THEN s.synonym END),
    MIN(s.synonym)

FROM (
  SELECT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_attachments"
  GROUP BY parent_key
  HAVING
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN LOWER(title) LIKE '%ema summary of product characteristics%' AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%retacrit%'
          THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) > 0
    AND
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN LOWER(title) LIKE '%fda%' AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%approv%' AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%first%'
               AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%epoetin alfa%' AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%biosimilar%' AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%anemia%'
          THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) > 0
) md
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  ON s.drugbank_id = md.parent_key
GROUP BY md.parent_key
LIMIT 50;

WITH antibody_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" ds

     OR lower(ds.synonym) LIKE '%monoclonal antibody %'
),
target_mechanism AS (
  -- Best-effort indicator from target annotations: look for any target action text mentioning 'antibody'
  SELECT
    t.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(t.known_action, '')) LIKE '%antibody%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS indicates_antibody_mechanism
  FROM "drugbank_targets" t
  GROUP BY t.parent_key
),
patents_us_pediatric AS (
  -- Heuristic: find U.S. patent links that mention pediatric extension and contain a YYYY-MM-DD date in the title
  SELECT
    dl.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
    -- Extract a date-like token starting at the first '20' (YYYY-MM-DD assumed)
    SUBSTR(dl.title, INSTR(dl.title, '20'), 10) AS expiration_date_guess,
    dl.title,
    dl.url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
  WHERE lower(COALESCE(dl.title, '')) LIKE '%patent%'
    AND (
          lower(dl.title) LIKE '%us%' OR lower(dl.title) LIKE '%u.s.%' OR COALESCE(dl.url, '') LIKE '%/US%'
        )
    AND lower(dl.title) LIKE '%pediatric%'
    AND dl.title LIKE '%20__-__-__%'
),
per_drug_exp_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.drugbank_id,
    p.expiration_date_guess,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM patents_us_pediatric p
  GROUP BY p.drugbank_id, p.expiration_date_guess
),
per_drug_exp_max AS (
  SELECT
    drugbank_id,
    MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt
  FROM per_drug_exp_counts
  GROUP BY drugbank_id
),
common_us_pediatric_expiration AS (
  -- Pick the most common expiration date per drug; in case of ties, choose the earliest lexically
  SELECT
    c.drugbank_id,
    MIN(c.expiration_date_guess) AS common_expiration_date
  FROM per_drug_exp_counts c
  JOIN per_drug_exp_max m
    ON m.drugbank_id = c.drugbank_id
   AND m.max_cnt = c.cnt
  GROUP BY c.drugbank_id
)
SELECT
  a.drugbank_id,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(tm.indicates_antibody_mechanism, 0) = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS target_action_indicates_antibody_mechanism,
  ce.common_expiration_date AS common_us_patent_expiration_with_pediatric_extension
FROM antibody_drugs a
LEFT JOIN target_mechanism tm
  ON tm.drugbank_id = a.drugbank_id
LEFT JOIN common_us_pediatric_expiration ce
  ON ce.drugbank_id = a.drugbank_id
LIMIT 50;

WITH prav AS (

  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%pravastatin%'

carriers AS (

  WHERE lower(c.organism) = 'humans'

SELECT carriers.human_carrier_proteins AS carrier_protein,

FROM snps
CROSS JOIN carriers

  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%fluvoxamine%'

  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  JOIN fluvox_parent fp ON fp.parent_key = l.parent_key
  WHERE LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%fda%' AND LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%label%'

SELECT
  l.ref_id AS pubmed_id,
  l.title AS study_title,
  l.url AS study_url,
  e.name AS weakly_inhibited_cyp_enzyme,
  e.inhibition_strength
FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" AS l
JOIN "drugbank_enzymes" AS e
  ON e.parent_key = l.parent_key
WHERE
  -- find the cyclosporine study mentioning intestinal P-gp (MDR1) and bioavailability
  LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%p-glycoprotein%'
  AND (LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%mdr1%' OR LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%multidrug resistance%')
  AND LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%cyclospor%'
  AND LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%bioavailab%'
  -- get human CYP enzyme(s) only weakly inhibited by the same drug
  AND e.organism = 'Humans'
  AND LOWER(e.name) LIKE 'cytochrome p450%'
  AND LOWER(e.inhibition_strength) LIKE 'weak%'
LIMIT 50;

SELECT DISTINCT

  ca.action AS carrier_action
FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
JOIN "drugbank_transporters" t

LEFT JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" tp

  ON ca.parent_id = t.id
WHERE LOWER(s.synonym) = 'etanercept'
  AND COALESCE(tp.amino_acid_format, tp.gene_format) IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.action IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 50;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE LOWER(synonym) IN ('dornase alpha', 'dornase alfa')
),
alt_syn AS (
  SELECT s.drugbank_id, s.synonym AS other_english_synonym
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  JOIN target t ON t.drugbank_id = s.drugbank_id
  WHERE s.language LIKE '%english%'
    AND LOWER(s.synonym) NOT IN ('dornase alpha', 'dornase alfa')
  LIMIT 1
),
companies AS (
  SELECT ib.drugbank_id, ib.company AS company, 1 AS priority
  FROM "drugbank_drug_international_brands" ib
  JOIN target t ON t.drugbank_id = ib.drugbank_id
  WHERE ib.company IS NOT NULL AND ib.company <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.drugbank_id, m.manufacturer AS company, 2 AS priority
  FROM "drugbank_drug_manufacturers" m
  JOIN target t ON t.drugbank_id = m.drugbank_id
  WHERE m.manufacturer IS NOT NULL AND m.manufacturer <> ''
)
SELECT c.company, a.other_english_synonym
FROM (
  SELECT drugbank_id, company
  FROM companies
  ORDER BY priority
  LIMIT 1
) c
JOIN alt_syn a ON a.drugbank_id = c.drugbank_id
LIMIT 50;

WITH preferred_names AS (
  SELECT s.drugbank_id, s.synonym AS drug_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  WHERE s.language = 'english'
    AND LENGTH(s.synonym) = (
      SELECT MIN(LENGTH(s2.synonym))
      FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s2
      WHERE s2.drugbank_id = s.drugbank_id AND s2.language = 'english'
    )
),
matches AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pn.drugbank_id, pn.drug_name
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  JOIN preferred_names pn
    ON l.title LIKE '%' || pn.drug_name || '%'
)
SELECT
  m.drug_name,
  m.drugbank_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.rs_id) AS num_genotype_adverse_reactions
FROM matches m
JOIN "drugbank_snp_adverse_reactions" a
  ON a.parent_key = m.drugbank_id
GROUP BY m.drug_name, m.drugbank_id
ORDER BY num_genotype_adverse_reactions DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  l.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(MIN(dr.left_drugbank_name), ''),
    NULLIF(MIN(dr.right_drugbank_name), ''),
    MIN(CASE WHEN s.language = 'english' THEN s.synonym END)
  ) AS drug_name,
  COUNT(*) AS reaction_records
FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" AS l
JOIN "drugbank_drug_reactions" AS dr
  ON dr.parent_key = l.parent_key
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drug_syn" AS s
  ON s.drugbank_id = l.parent_key
WHERE LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%fda%approved%drug%products%'
GROUP BY l.parent_key
ORDER BY reaction_records DESC, drugbank_id
LIMIT 50;

P-glycoprotein 1 (P-gp, MDR1; gene ABCB1). PubMed evidence: PMID 17045309. Specific function: an ATP-dependent efflux pump that exports many xenobiotics/drugs from cells, leading to decreased intracellular drug accumulation (DrugBank: “Energy-dependent efflux pump responsible for decreased drug accumulation in multidrug-resistant cells.”).

Structured data link cyclosporine (DrugBank DB00091) to the human ABCB1-encoded transporter P-glycoprotein 1 in the drugbank_transporters table, and the drugbank_transporters_polypeptides table lists ABCB1’s specific function as an energy-dependent drug efflux pump. Although our SQL query did not retrieve SNP-based oral bioavailability entries for ABCB1 and cyclosporine, unstructured evidence in the provided literature shows cyclosporine A is a transported substrate of P-gp (PMID 17045309), a key efflux transporter expressed in the intestinal epithelium. Because intestinal P-gp limits drug absorption, its transport of cyclosporine is directly implicated in differences in oral bioavailability. Thus, the human membrane efflux transporter is P-glycoprotein 1 (ABCB1), and its specific function is ATP-driven efflux of drugs/xenobiotics, reducing intracellular accumulation.

WITH evidence AS (
  SELECT parent_key, pubmed_id, description
  FROM "drugbank_drug_snp_effects"
  WHERE UPPER(gene_symbol) = 'ABCB1'
    AND parent_key = 'DB00091'
    AND LOWER(description) LIKE '%oral%'
    AND LOWER(description) LIKE '%bioavail%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT parent_key, pubmed_id, description
  FROM "drugbank_snp_adverse_reactions"
  WHERE UPPER(gene_symbol) = 'ABCB1'
    AND parent_key = 'DB00091'
    AND LOWER(description) LIKE '%oral%'
    AND LOWER(description) LIKE '%bioavail%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  t.name AS transporter_name,
  p.gene_name,
  p.organism,
  p.cellular_location,
  p.specific_function,
  e.pubmed_id,
  e.description AS evidence_description
FROM "drugbank_transporters" t
JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" p
  ON p.parent_id = t.id
JOIN evidence e
  ON e.parent_key = t.parent_key
WHERE t.organism = 'Humans'
  AND p.organism = 'Humans'
  AND UPPER(p.gene_name) = 'ABCB1'
LIMIT 50;

WITH cte_drug AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE TRIM(LOWER(synonym)) = TRIM(LOWER('Cétuximab'))

action_counts AS (

    t.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
    COALESCE(t.known_action, 'unknown') AS action_type,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM "drugbank_targets" t

  GROUP BY t.parent_key, action_type

    action_type,

  FROM action_counts
)
SELECT
  d.drugbank_id,
  ta.action_type AS most_frequent_action

  ON ta.drugbank_id = d.drugbank_id

  a.pubmed_id AS albumin_ascorbate_pubmed_id
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT gene_name
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides"
  WHERE organism = 'Humans'
    AND name = 'Cytochrome P450 1A2'
  LIMIT 1
) e
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT pubmed_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_carriers_articles"
  WHERE lower(citation) LIKE '%albumin%'
    AND lower(citation) LIKE '%ascorbate%'
    AND lower(citation) LIKE '%bind%'
  ORDER BY pubmed_id
  LIMIT 1

WITH syn_choice AS (
  SELECT
    s.drugbank_id,
    s.synonym,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.drugbank_id
      ORDER BY
        CASE
          WHEN s.coder LIKE '%inn%' THEN 0
          WHEN s.coder LIKE '%usan%' THEN 1
          ELSE 2
        END,
        LENGTH(s.synonym)
    ) AS rn
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  WHERE s.language LIKE '%english%'
)

FROM "drugbank_drug_patents" p
JOIN "drugbank_drug_atc_codes" a
  ON a.drugbank_id = p.parent_key
LEFT JOIN syn_choice sc
  ON sc.drugbank_id = a.drugbank_id AND sc.rn = 1
WHERE a.level_1 = 'Direct thrombin inhibitors'
  AND p.country = 'United States'
  AND p.expires = '2029-01-27'
  AND (
    p.pediatric_extension = 1
    OR LOWER(CAST(p.pediatric_extension AS TEXT)) IN ('true','t','1','yes','y')
  )
LIMIT 50;

WITH inhalation_solutions AS (
  SELECT parent_key, strength
  FROM "drugbank_drug_dosages"
  WHERE lower(form) LIKE '%solution%' AND lower(route) = 'inhalation'
  LIMIT 1
),
oatp_polypeptides AS (
  SELECT name, gene_name, general_function, specific_function
  FROM "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides"
  WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%organic anion transporting polypeptide%' OR lower(gene_name) LIKE 'slco%'
),
pfam_extracted AS (
  SELECT
    name,
    gene_name,
    general_function,
    specific_function,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(upper(general_function), 'PF') > 0 THEN substr(upper(general_function), instr(upper(general_function), 'PF'), 7)
      WHEN instr(upper(specific_function), 'PF') > 0 THEN substr(upper(specific_function), instr(upper(specific_function), 'PF'), 7)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS pfam_id
  FROM oatp_polypeptides
),
pfam_one AS (
  SELECT pfam_id
  FROM pfam_extracted
  WHERE pfam_id IS NOT NULL
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 'inhalation_solution_strength' AS item, s.strength AS value, s.parent_key AS context
FROM inhalation_solutions s
UNION ALL
SELECT 'oatp_pfam_identifier' AS item, p.pfam_id AS value, NULL AS context
FROM pfam_one p
LIMIT 50;

Cubilin, in complex with amnionless (the CUBAM complex), binds the intrinsic factor–vitamin B12 complex at the apical surface of ileal enterocytes and mediates its endocytic uptake. This function is commonly described in UniProt/DrugBank summaries as being required for efficient intestinal absorption of cobalamin. (The transcobalamin receptor CD320 functions systemically for cellular uptake from blood, not for luminal intestinal absorption.)

WITH neulasta_drug AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE LOWER(synonym) IN ('neulasta', 'pegfilgrastim')
),
fda AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ref_id AS fda_label_ref_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_enzymes_links" l
  JOIN neulasta_drug d ON l.parent_key = d.drugbank_id
  WHERE LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%fda%' AND LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%label%'
  ORDER BY l.ref_id
  LIMIT 1
),
cyp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uniprot_id AS cyp1a2_uniprot_id
  FROM "drugbank_snp_adverse_reactions"
  WHERE UPPER(gene_symbol) = 'CYP1A2' AND uniprot_id IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY uniprot_id
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT f.fda_label_ref_id, c.cyp1a2_uniprot_id
FROM fda f
CROSS JOIN cyp c
LIMIT 50;

WITH manu AS (
  SELECT title AS manufacturer_name
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE parent_key = :drug_id
    AND (
      title LIKE '%Pharma%' OR
      title LIKE '%Pharmaceutical%' OR
      title LIKE '%Laborator%' OR
      title LIKE '%Inc.%' OR
      title LIKE '% Inc' OR
      title LIKE '%Ltd%' OR
      title LIKE '%LLC%' OR
      title LIKE '%Corp%' OR
      title LIKE '%Company%' OR
      title LIKE '%S.A.%' OR
      title LIKE '%GmbH%' OR
      title LIKE '%S.p.A%' OR
      title LIKE '%Limited%'
    )
  LIMIT 1
),
carrier AS (
  SELECT
    c.name AS carrier_name,
    p.gene_name
  FROM "drugbank_carriers" c
  JOIN "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" p
    ON p.parent_id = c.id
  WHERE c.parent_key = :drug_id
    AND c.organism = 'Humans'
    AND (
      c.name = 'Thyroxine-binding globulin'
      OR c.id IN (
        SELECT s.parent_key
        FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_syn" s
        WHERE s.text IN ('Thyroxine-binding globulin','TBG','T4-binding globulin','Serpin A7')
      )
    )
    AND (p.cellular_location LIKE '%Secreted%' OR p.cellular_location LIKE '%Extracellular%')
  ORDER BY c.position
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(manu.manufacturer_name, 'Unknown manufacturer') AS manufacturer_name,
  carrier.carrier_name,
  carrier.gene_name
FROM carrier
LEFT JOIN manu ON 1=1

WITH pub AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      CASE
        WHEN url LIKE '%pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/%' THEN
          substr(
            substr(url, instr(url,'pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/') + length('pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/')),
            1,
            CASE
              WHEN instr(substr(url, instr(url,'pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/') + length('pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/')), '/') > 0
                THEN instr(substr(url, instr(url,'pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/') + length('pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/')), '/') - 1
              ELSE length(substr(url, instr(url,'pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/') + length('pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/')))
            END
          )
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN url LIKE '%ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/%' THEN
          substr(
            substr(url, instr(url,'ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/') + length('ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/')),
            1,
            CASE
              WHEN instr(substr(url, instr(url,'ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/') + length('ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/')), '/') > 0
                THEN instr(substr(url, instr(url,'ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/') + length('ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/')), '/') - 1
              ELSE length(substr(url, instr(url,'ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/') + length('ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/')))
            END
          )
      END

  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE url LIKE '%pubmed%'
    AND title LIKE '%paroxetine%' COLLATE NOCASE
    AND title LIKE '%methadone%' COLLATE NOCASE
  LIMIT 1

WITH
tp AS (
  SELECT id, name, parent_id
  FROM "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides"
  WHERE name IN (:polypeptide1, :polypeptide2)
),
tp1 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM tp
  WHERE name = :polypeptide1
),
tp2 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM tp
  WHERE name = :polypeptide2
),
shared_drug AS (
  SELECT t1.parent_key AS drug_id
  FROM tp1 p1
  JOIN "drugbank_transporters" t1 ON t1.id = p1.parent_id
  JOIN tp2 p2
  JOIN "drugbank_transporters" t2 ON t2.id = p2.parent_id
  WHERE t1.parent_key = t2.parent_key
  LIMIT 1
),
shared_pfams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f1.identifier, f1.name
  FROM tp1 p1
  JOIN "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_pfams" f1 ON f1.parent_key = p1.id
  JOIN tp2 p2
  JOIN "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_pfams" f2
    ON f2.parent_key = p2.id
   AND f2.identifier = f1.identifier
)
SELECT
  sp.identifier AS pfam_id,
  sp.name AS pfam_name,
  (
    SELECT rr.name
    FROM (
      SELECT dr.right_drugbank_name AS name, dr.sequence
      FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions" dr
      JOIN shared_drug sd ON sd.drug_id = dr.parent_key
      WHERE dr.right_drugbank_id LIKE 'BE%'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT dr2.left_drugbank_name AS name, dr2.sequence
      FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions" dr2
      JOIN shared_drug sd2 ON sd2.drug_id = dr2.parent_key
      WHERE dr2.left_drugbank_id LIKE 'BE%'
    ) rr
    WHERE rr.name IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY rr.sequence
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS one_enzyme_in_associated_drug_pathway
FROM shared_pfams sp
LIMIT 50;

  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"

t3_transporters AS (

  JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" dtp

  ON cl.parent_key = t3t.parent_key
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
  extracell.description AS extracellular_location,
  fda.title AS fda_label_title
FROM
  (
    SELECT g.description
    FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" cp
    JOIN "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_go" g
      ON g.parent_key = cp.parent_id
    WHERE
      g.category = 'component'
      AND LOWER(g.description) LIKE 'extracellular%'
      AND (
        (LOWER(cp.general_function) LIKE '%hormone%' AND LOWER(cp.general_function) LIKE '%serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor%')
        OR LOWER(cp.name) LIKE '%thyroxine-binding globulin%'
        OR (LOWER(cp.specific_function) LIKE '%hormone%' AND LOWER(cp.general_function) LIKE '%serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor%')
      )
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS extracell
CROSS JOIN
  (
    SELECT dl.title
    FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
    WHERE
      (LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%cyclosporine%' OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%cyclosporin%')
      AND LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%label%'
      AND (LOWER(dl.url) LIKE '%fda.gov%' OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%fda%')
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fda
LIMIT 50;

SELECT

  p.id AS uniprot_accession,
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1

  ON dpe2.enzyme = p.id
WHERE e.name LIKE '%Vitamin D 25-hydroxylase%'
   OR p.name LIKE '%Vitamin D 25-hydroxylase%'
GROUP BY e.name, p.id
LIMIT 50;

GROUP BY a.drugbank_id
ORDER BY a.drugbank_id
LIMIT 50;

positions AS (
  SELECT ref_id, 1 AS n, text FROM links
  UNION ALL

  FROM positions
  WHERE n + 4 <= LENGTH(text)
),
years_all AS (
  SELECT
    p.ref_id,
    CAST(SUBSTR(p.text, p.n, 4) AS INT) AS y
  FROM positions p
  WHERE SUBSTR(p.text, p.n, 4) GLOB '[12][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
    AND CAST(SUBSTR(p.text, p.n, 4) AS INT) BETWEEN 1990 AND 2100
),

    ya.ref_id,

),

           (SELECT MAX(y) FROM years_all)

),

  SELECT
    b.book_year,
    e.expiry_year,

  FROM book b
  CROSS JOIN expiry e
)

LIMIT 50;

  SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN left_drugbank_name LIKE 'Cytochrome P450 %' THEN left_drugbank_name
      WHEN right_drugbank_name LIKE 'Cytochrome P450 %' THEN right_drugbank_name
    END AS cyp_enzyme
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE parent_key = 'DB00022'
    AND (
      left_drugbank_name LIKE 'Cytochrome P450 %'
      OR right_drugbank_name LIKE 'Cytochrome P450 %'
    )
  ORDER BY cyp_enzyme
  LIMIT 1
),
syn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.text AS transporter_synonym
  FROM "drugbank_transporters" t
  LEFT JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" p
    ON p.parent_id = t.id
  LEFT JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides_syn" s
    ON s.parent_key = p.id OR s.parent_key = t.id
  WHERE t.parent_key = 'DB00022'
    AND t.organism = 'Humans'
    AND t.name LIKE '%P-glycoprotein 1%'
    AND s.text IS NOT NULL
    AND s.text <> t.name
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN s.text = 'MDR1' THEN 0
      WHEN s.text = 'ABCB1' THEN 1
      ELSE 2
    END,
    s.text
  LIMIT 1
)

WITH
egfr_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_targets"
  WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%epidermal growth factor receptor%'
    AND LOWER(COALESCE(known_action,'')) = 'yes'
),
egfr_drug_target_counts AS (
  SELECT parent_key, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS target_count
  FROM "drugbank_targets"
  WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT parent_key FROM egfr_drugs)
  GROUP BY parent_key
),
egfr_max AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(target_count), 0) AS egfr_target_count
  FROM egfr_drug_target_counts
),
vitaminD_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_targets"
  WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%vitamin d%'
),
vitaminD_textbook_counts AS (
  SELECT parent_key, COUNT(*) AS textbook_count
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT parent_key FROM vitaminD_drugs)
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(title,'')) LIKE '%textbook%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(title,'')) LIKE '%goodman%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(title,'')) LIKE '%gilman%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(title,'')) LIKE '%martindale%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(title,'')) LIKE '%pharmacology%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(url,'')) LIKE '%book%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(url,'')) LIKE '%books%'
    )
  GROUP BY parent_key
),
vitaminD_max AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(textbook_count), 0) AS vitaminD_textbook_count
  FROM vitaminD_textbook_counts
)
SELECT
  e.egfr_target_count,
  v.vitaminD_textbook_count,
  CASE
    WHEN e.egfr_target_count > v.vitaminD_textbook_count THEN 'EGFR-targeted drug has more targets'
    WHEN e.egfr_target_count < v.vitaminD_textbook_count THEN 'Vitamin D–related drug has more textbook references'
    ELSE 'Counts are equal'
  END AS which_is_greater,
  ABS(e.egfr_target_count - v.vitaminD_textbook_count) AS count_difference
FROM egfr_max e
CROSS JOIN vitaminD_max v
LIMIT 50;

WITH candidates(parent_key) AS (
  VALUES
    ('DB00001'),  -- replace with candidate drug 1 ID
    ('DB00002')   -- replace with candidate drug 2 ID

ipi AS (
  SELECT ep.parent_key, MIN(CAST(ep.value AS REAL)) AS isoelectric_point
  FROM "drugbank_drug_experimental_properties" ep
  JOIN candidates c ON c.parent_key = ep.parent_key
  WHERE LOWER(ep.kind) = 'isoelectric point'
  GROUP BY ep.parent_key
),
mw AS (
  SELECT ep.parent_key, MIN(CAST(ep.value AS REAL)) AS molecular_weight
  FROM "drugbank_drug_experimental_properties" ep
  JOIN candidates c ON c.parent_key = ep.parent_key
  WHERE LOWER(ep.kind) LIKE 'molecular weight%'
  GROUP BY ep.parent_key

drug_names AS (
  SELECT parent_key, MIN(title) AS drug_title
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT parent_key FROM candidates)
  GROUP BY parent_key

SELECT
  i.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  dn.drug_title,
  i.isoelectric_point,
  m.molecular_weight
FROM ipi i
LEFT JOIN mw m ON m.parent_key = i.parent_key
LEFT JOIN drug_names dn ON dn.parent_key = i.parent_key
ORDER BY i.isoelectric_point ASC
LIMIT 1;

  SELECT

    l.title AS acetate_salt_name,

sql_executed:
WITH cyan AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%cyanocobalamin%'
  LIMIT 1
),
conv AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%hydroxocobalamin%' THEN 'Hydroxocobalamin'
      WHEN lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%adenosylcobalamin%' THEN 'Adenosylcobalamin'
      WHEN lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%methylcobalamin%' THEN 'Methylcobalamin'
      ELSE right_drugbank_name
    END AS converted_cobalamin
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%cyanocobalamin%'
     OR left_drugbank_id IN (SELECT parent_key FROM cyan)
     OR right_drugbank_id IN (SELECT parent_key FROM cyan)
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%hydroxocobalamin%' THEN 0
      WHEN lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%adenosylcobalamin%' THEN 1
      WHEN lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%methylcobalamin%' THEN 2
      ELSE 3
    END
  LIMIT 1
),
ileum_candidates AS (
  SELECT cp.gene_name AS gene_name, cp.name AS protein_name, cp.specific_function AS sf
  FROM "drugbank_carriers" c
  JOIN "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" cp ON cp.parent_id = c.id
  WHERE c.parent_key IN (SELECT parent_key FROM cyan)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT tp.gene_name, tp.name, tp.specific_function
  FROM "drugbank_transporters" t
  JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" tp ON tp.parent_id = t.id
  WHERE t.parent_key IN (SELECT parent_key FROM cyan)
),
ileum AS (
  SELECT gene_name AS ileum_absorption_gene, protein_name AS ileum_absorption_protein
  FROM ileum_candidates
  WHERE (lower(sf) LIKE '%ileum%')
     OR gene_name IN ('CUBN','GIF','AMN')
     OR lower(protein_name) LIKE '%intrinsic factor%'
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN gene_name = 'CUBN' THEN 0
      WHEN gene_name = 'GIF' THEN 1
      WHEN gene_name = 'AMN' THEN 2
      ELSE 3
    END
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT converted_cobalamin FROM conv) AS converted_cobalamin,
  (SELECT ileum_absorption_gene FROM ileum) AS ileum_absorption_gene
LIMIT 50;

WITH us_patents AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ref_id
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE parent_key = 'DB00007'
    AND (LOWER(title) LIKE '%patent%' OR LOWER(url) LIKE '%patent%')
    AND (
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%united states%'
      OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%us patent%'
      OR LOWER(url) LIKE '%uspto%'
      OR LOWER(url) LIKE '%/patent/us%'
    )
),
human_carriers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id
  FROM "drugbank_carriers"
  WHERE parent_key = 'DB00162'
    AND LOWER(organism) LIKE 'human%'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM us_patents) AS us_patent_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM human_carriers) AS human_carrier_count
)
SELECT
  us_patent_count,
  human_carrier_count,
  CASE
    WHEN us_patent_count > human_carrier_count THEN 'US patents for DB00007 larger'
    WHEN us_patent_count < human_carrier_count THEN 'Human carriers for DB00162 larger'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS which_is_larger
FROM counts

Albumin; etanercept is expected to decrease the therapeutic efficacy of the inactivated Influenza A (H3N2) vaccine antigen.

Albumin (human serum albumin, ALB) is a secreted human plasma carrier protein that non-specifically binds many drugs and can affect their distribution, as evidenced by studies showing major serum components including albumin reduce free drug availability (Passages 1 and 4). The drug–drug interaction entry from the SQL query (drugbank_query_ddi_table) indicates that when etanercept is co-administered with an inactivated Influenza A (H3N2) vaccine antigen, the vaccine’s therapeutic efficacy can be decreased. This aligns with the known potential of immunosuppressive biologics like etanercept to blunt vaccine responses.

SELECT
  (
    SELECT cpp.name
    FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" AS cpp
    JOIN "drugbank_carriers" AS c ON cpp.parent_id = c.id
    WHERE c.organism = 'Human'
      AND (cpp.name LIKE '%albumin%' OR cpp.gene_name = 'ALB')
      AND (cpp.cellular_location LIKE '%Secreted%' OR cpp.cellular_location IS NULL)
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS secreted_plasma_carrier_protein_affecting_distribution,
  (
    SELECT interaction
    FROM "drugbank_query_ddi_table"
    WHERE
      (
        (UPPER(drug1) LIKE '%ETANERCEPT%' AND UPPER(drug2) LIKE '%INFLUENZA%' AND UPPER(drug2) LIKE '%H3N2%' AND UPPER(drug2) LIKE '%INACT%')
        OR
        (UPPER(drug2) LIKE '%ETANERCEPT%' AND UPPER(drug1) LIKE '%INFLUENZA%' AND UPPER(drug1) LIKE '%H3N2%' AND UPPER(drug1) LIKE '%INACT%')
      )
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS etanercept_effect_on_inactivated_influenza_A_H3N2_vaccine
LIMIT 50;

sql_executed:
WITH grapefruit_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dfi.drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_food_interactions" dfi
  WHERE LOWER(dfi.food_interaction) LIKE '%grapefruit%'
),
candidate_transporters AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.name
  FROM "drugbank_transporters" t
  INNER JOIN grapefruit_drugs gd ON gd.drugbank_id = t.parent_key
  WHERE LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%glycoprotein%'
     OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%mdr1%'
     OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%abcb1%'
     OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%multidrug resistance protein 1%'
),
transporter_hit AS (
  SELECT MIN(name) AS transporter_name
  FROM candidate_transporters
),
most_expensive_tablet AS (
  SELECT p.description AS product_description, p.cost AS product_cost
  FROM "drugbank_drug_prices" p
  INNER JOIN grapefruit_drugs gd ON gd.drugbank_id = p.parent_key
  WHERE p.currency = 'USD' AND LOWER(p.unit) = 'tablet'
  ORDER BY p.cost DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT th.transporter_name AS transporter_activated_by_grapefruit_juice,
       met.product_description AS highest_cost_tablet_product,
       met.product_cost AS highest_cost_per_tablet_usd
FROM transporter_hit th
CROSS JOIN most_expensive_tablet met
LIMIT 50;

  FROM "drugbank_drug_pathway"

acts AS (

  FROM "drugbank_targets" t
  JOIN stp s ON s.parent_key = t.parent_key
  WHERE t.known_action IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.known_action) <> ''
  GROUP BY t.parent_key, t.known_action
)
SELECT
  s.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  (
    SELECT a.known_action

    ORDER BY a.cnt DESC, a.known_action
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS most_common_enzyme_action
FROM stp s

WITH
-- Identify ABC transporter polypeptides
abc_transporters AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.parent_id
  FROM "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" t
  WHERE 
    t.name LIKE '%ABC%' 
    OR t.gene_name LIKE 'ABC%' 
    OR t.general_function LIKE '%ATP-binding cassette%' 
    OR t.specific_function LIKE '%ATP-binding cassette%'
),
-- Map any available Pfam annotations (by BE parent_id) to those transporters
abc_pfams AS (
  SELECT p.parent_key, p.identifier, p.name
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_pfams" p
  JOIN abc_transporters a ON a.parent_id = p.parent_key
),
-- Count Pfam co-occurrence pairs within the same transporter
pfam_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    p1.identifier AS pfam1_id,
    p1.name AS pfam1_name,
    p2.identifier AS pfam2_id,
    p2.name AS pfam2_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p1.parent_key) AS cooccurrence_count
  FROM abc_pfams p1
  JOIN abc_pfams p2
    ON p1.parent_key = p2.parent_key
   AND (p1.identifier < p2.identifier OR (p1.identifier = p2.identifier AND p1.name < p2.name))
  GROUP BY pfam1_id, pfam1_name, pfam2_id, pfam2_name
),
-- Find drugs with names containing 'acetate' from interaction records (proxy for acetate salts)
acetate_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT name FROM (
    SELECT left_drugbank_name AS name
    FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
    WHERE lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%acetate%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT right_drugbank_name AS name
    FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
    WHERE lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%acetate%'
  )
),
-- Top Pfam pair among ABC transporters
top_pfam_pair AS (
  SELECT pfam1_id, pfam1_name, pfam2_id, pfam2_name, cooccurrence_count
  FROM pfam_pairs
  ORDER BY cooccurrence_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
-- Output: the most common Pfam pair among ABC transporters and a list of candidate acetate salt drugs (mass not available in provided tables)
SELECT 'ABC_transporter_top_Pfam_pair' AS section,
       pfam1_id || ' (' || pfam1_name || ')' AS item1,
       pfam2_id || ' (' || pfam2_name || ')' AS item2,
       cooccurrence_count AS metric
FROM top_pfam_pair
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Acetate_salt_drug_candidates' AS section,
       name AS item1,
       NULL AS item2,
       NULL AS metric
FROM acetate_drugs
LIMIT 50;

sql_executed:
SELECT m.metabolite, l.title AS fda_label_title
FROM
(
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE 'cyanocobalamin%' THEN COALESCE(right_drugbank_name, right_drugbank_id)
      WHEN lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE 'cyanocobalamin%' THEN COALESCE(left_drugbank_name, left_drugbank_id)
    END AS metabolite
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE (lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE 'cyanocobalamin%' OR lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE 'cyanocobalamin%')
    AND (left_drugbank_name IS NOT NULL OR right_drugbank_name IS NOT NULL)
  LIMIT 1
) AS m
CROSS JOIN
(
  SELECT dl.title
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  JOIN "drugbank_drugs_links" dl ON dl.parent_key = s.drugbank_id
  WHERE lower(s.synonym) LIKE 'cetirizine%'
    AND lower(dl.title) LIKE '%fda%'
    AND lower(dl.title) LIKE '%label%'
  ORDER BY dl.title
  LIMIT 1
) AS l
LIMIT 50;

WITH shared_pathway_drugs AS (
  SELECT parent_key AS drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%one carbon pool by folate%'
     OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%folate biosynthesis%'
  GROUP BY parent_key
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(title) LIKE '%one carbon pool by folate%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(title) LIKE '%folate biosynthesis%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
drug_names AS (
  SELECT s.drugbank_id,
         MIN(s.synonym) AS drug_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  JOIN shared_pathway_drugs sp ON s.drugbank_id = sp.drugbank_id
  GROUP BY s.drugbank_id
),
vitb12_membrane_gene AS (
  SELECT gene_name
  FROM "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides"
  WHERE (LOWER(specific_function) LIKE '%vitamin b12%'
         OR LOWER(general_function) LIKE '%vitamin b12%'
         OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%cubilin%')
    AND (cellular_location IS NULL OR LOWER(cellular_location) LIKE '%membrane%')
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(name) LIKE '%cubilin%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, gene_name
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT dn.drug_name,
       dn.drugbank_id,
       (SELECT gene_name FROM vitb12_membrane_gene) AS vitamin_b12_absorption_membrane_gene
FROM drug_names dn
LIMIT 50;

WITH links AS (
  SELECT ref_id, parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE ref_id IS NOT NULL
),

  SELECT
    'across_different_parents' AS duplicate_type,
    ref_id,
    NULL AS parent_key,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT parent_key) AS parent_keys_list,
    COUNT(*) AS occurrences,

    ref_id,

  FROM links
  GROUP BY ref_id, parent_key
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT *
FROM cross_parent
UNION ALL
SELECT *
FROM same_parent
ORDER BY duplicate_type, occurrences DESC, ref_id, parent_key

FROM
  -- Identify the study mentioning paroxetine and methadone (PubMed ID)

WITH params AS (
  SELECT 'PF00067' AS pfam_accession -- set to the specified Pfam accession (e.g., PF00067 for Cytochrome P450)
),
study AS (
  SELECT
    dl.title AS study_title,
    dl.url   AS study_url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
  WHERE LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%peginterferon%'
    AND (LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%cytochrome p450%' OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%cyp%')
  ORDER BY dl.title
  LIMIT 1
),
pfam AS (
  SELECT
    dl.ref_id AS pfam_accession,
    dl.title  AS pfam_family_name,
    dl.url    AS pfam_url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
  JOIN params p ON dl.ref_id = p.pfam_accession
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  study.study_title,
  study.study_url,
  pfam.pfam_family_name,
  pfam.pfam_url,
  pfam.pfam_accession
FROM study
CROSS JOIN pfam
LIMIT 50;

WITH cyp AS (
  SELECT uniprot_id AS cyp3a4_uniprot_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions_enzymes"
  WHERE name = 'Cytochrome P450 3A4'
  LIMIT 1
),
params AS (
  -- Bind the known price per milliliter (USD) for Ontak here in place of the ? parameter
  SELECT 'Ontak' AS product_name, '150 mcg/mL' AS concentration, 10.0 AS volume_ml, CAST(? AS REAL) AS price_per_ml_usd
)
SELECT
  c.cyp3a4_uniprot_id,
  p.product_name,
  p.concentration,
  p.volume_ml,
  p.price_per_ml_usd,
  ROUND(p.volume_ml * p.price_per_ml_usd, 2) AS total_cost_usd
FROM cyp c
CROSS JOIN params p
LIMIT 50;

WITH lepirudin_links AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dl.parent_key AS drugbank_id, dl.title AS resource, dl.ref_id, dl.url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
  JOIN "drugbank_drug_syn" s ON s.drugbank_id = dl.parent_key
  WHERE lower(s.synonym) LIKE 'lepirudin%'
),
serum_albumin_pfam AS (

WITH section AS (
  SELECT 'Enzymes and Transporters sections' AS coverage
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "drugbank_enzymes" e WHERE lower(e.name) LIKE 'cytochrome p450 3a%')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "drugbank_transporters" t WHERE lower(t.name) LIKE 'p-glycoprotein%')
),
chol25 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         name,
         CASE
           WHEN instr(name, 'EC ') > 0 THEN
             CASE
               WHEN instr(substr(name, instr(name, 'EC ')+3), ')') > 0
               THEN substr(
                      name,
                      instr(name,'EC ')+3,
                      instr(substr(name, instr(name,'EC ')+3), ')') - 1
                    )
               ELSE substr(name, instr(name,'EC ')+3)
             END
           ELSE NULL
         END AS ec_number
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes"
  WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%cholesterol 25-hydroxylase%'
     OR lower(name) LIKE '%cholesterol-25-hydroxylase%'
     OR lower(name) LIKE '%cholesterol 25 hydroxylase%'
)
SELECT 'document_or_section' AS item, coverage AS value
FROM section
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cholesterol_25-hydroxylase_ec', COALESCE(ec_number, name) AS value
FROM chol25
LIMIT 50;

WITH citalopram_parent AS (
  SELECT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE LOWER(title) = LOWER('Citalopram MedSafe NZ Data Sheet')

WITH weak_cyps AS (

    e.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
    e.name AS enzyme_name

WITH
drug AS (
  SELECT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE lower(synonym) = 'octreotide acetate'
  LIMIT 1
),
cas_candidates AS (
  SELECT s.synonym AS cas
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  JOIN drug d ON s.drugbank_id = d.drugbank_id
  WHERE s.synonym GLOB '[0-9-]*'
    AND (length(s.synonym) - length(replace(s.synonym, '-', ''))) = 2
),
positions AS (
  SELECT
    cas,
    instr(cas, '-') AS p1,
    instr(substr(cas, instr(cas, '-') + 1), '-') AS p2rel
  FROM cas_candidates
),
cas_filtered AS (
  SELECT cas AS cas_number
  FROM positions
  WHERE
    (p2rel - 1) = 2
    AND
    (length(cas) - (p1 + p2rel)) = 1
  LIMIT 1
),
target_id AS (
  SELECT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_targets_polypeptides_syn"
  WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbb-1%'
  LIMIT 1

target_syn AS (
  SELECT text AS protein_synonym

  WHERE parent_key = (SELECT parent_key FROM target_id)

SELECT DISTINCT
  dl.title AS pathway_name,
  tpp.gene_name AS transporter_gene
FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" AS dl
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_transporters" AS t
  ON t.parent_key = dl.parent_key
  AND t.organism = 'Humans'
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" AS tpp
  ON tpp.parent_id = t.id
  AND tpp.organism = 'Humans'
WHERE dl.parent_key = :drug_id
  AND lower(dl.title) LIKE '%pathway%'
  AND (
    (lower(COALESCE(tpp.general_function, '')) LIKE '%efflux%' AND (lower(tpp.general_function) LIKE '%atp%' OR lower(tpp.general_function) LIKE '%energy%'))
    OR
    (lower(COALESCE(tpp.specific_function, '')) LIKE '%efflux%' AND (lower(tpp.specific_function) LIKE '%atp%' OR lower(tpp.specific_function) LIKE '%energy%'))
    OR
    lower(t.name) LIKE '%p-glycoprotein%'
  )

WITH syn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.drugbank_id AS id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  WHERE lower(s.synonym) = lower(:drug)
),
input_drugs AS (
  SELECT id FROM syn
  UNION ALL
  SELECT :drug AS id
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM syn)
),
target_minpos AS (
  SELECT parent_key AS id, MIN(position) AS min_pos
  FROM "drugbank_targets"
  WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT id FROM input_drugs)
  GROUP BY parent_key
),
chosen_target AS (
  SELECT t.parent_key AS id, MIN(t.name) AS target_name
  FROM "drugbank_targets" t
  JOIN target_minpos m ON m.id = t.parent_key
  WHERE (m.min_pos IS NULL AND t.position IS NULL) OR t.position = m.min_pos
  GROUP BY t.parent_key
),
ahfs AS (
  SELECT a.drugbank_id AS id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atc_code) AS ahfs_code_count
  FROM "drugbank_drug_atc_codes" a
  WHERE a.drugbank_id IN (SELECT id FROM input_drugs)
  GROUP BY a.drugbank_id
),
unis AS (
  SELECT se.parent_key AS id, se.uniprot_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_snp_effects" se
  JOIN chosen_target ct ON ct.id = se.parent_key AND se.protein_name = ct.target_name
  UNION
  SELECT ar.parent_key AS id, ar.uniprot_id
  FROM "drugbank_snp_adverse_reactions" ar
  JOIN chosen_target ct ON ct.id = ar.parent_key AND ar.protein_name = ct.target_name
),
uni_counts AS (
  SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT uniprot_id) AS uniprot_id_count
  FROM unis
  GROUP BY id
)
SELECT
  ids.id AS drugbank_id,
  COALESCE(a.ahfs_code_count, 0) AS ahfs_code_count,
  COALESCE(u.uniprot_id_count, 0) AS uniprot_id_count,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(a.ahfs_code_count, 0) > COALESCE(u.uniprot_id_count, 0) THEN 'greater'
    WHEN COALESCE(a.ahfs_code_count, 0) < COALESCE(u.uniprot_id_count, 0) THEN 'less'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS ahfs_vs_uniprot,
  ct.target_name AS chosen_target_name
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM input_drugs) AS ids
LEFT JOIN ahfs a ON a.id = ids.id
LEFT JOIN uni_counts u ON u.id = ids.id
LEFT JOIN chosen_target ct ON ct.id = ids.id
LIMIT 50;

WITH
fluvox_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT left_drugbank_id AS dbid
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE lower(left_drugbank_name) = 'fluvoxamine'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT right_drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE lower(right_drugbank_name) = 'fluvoxamine'
),
fda_label AS (
  SELECT url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE
    (
      parent_key IN (SELECT dbid FROM fluvox_ids)
      OR lower(title) LIKE '%fluvoxamine%'
      OR lower(url) LIKE '%fluvoxamine%'
    )
    AND (
      lower(title) LIKE '%fda%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%fda%'
    )
    AND (
      lower(title) LIKE '%label%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%prescribing%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%label%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%prescribing%'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN url LIKE '%accessdata.fda.gov%' THEN 1
      WHEN url LIKE '%dailymed.nlm.nih.gov%' THEN 2
      ELSE 3
    END,
    length(url)
  LIMIT 1
),
book AS (
  SELECT isbn
  FROM "drugbank_drug_trans_textbooks"
  WHERE lower(citation) LIKE '%predictive drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics%'
  UNION
  SELECT isbn
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_textbooks"
  WHERE lower(citation) LIKE '%predictive drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics%'
  UNION
  SELECT isbn
  FROM "drugbank_drug_carriers_textbooks"
  WHERE lower(citation) LIKE '%predictive drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics%'
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  d_id AS drugbank_id,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT transporter_name) AS human_transporter_for_gastrointestinal_vitamin_b12_absorption,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT carrier_hormone_go_function) AS carrier_molecular_function_term_indicating_hormone_interaction
FROM (
  -- Human transporter associated with the drug whose GO annotation mentions intestinal/vitamin B12 absorption
  SELECT
    t.parent_key AS d_id,
    t.name AS transporter_name,
    NULL AS carrier_hormone_go_function
  FROM "drugbank_transporters" t
  JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides_go" tg
    ON tg.parent_key = t.id
  WHERE t.parent_key = ?
    AND t.organism = 'Humans'
    AND (
      LOWER(tg.description) LIKE '%vitamin b12%' OR
      LOWER(tg.description) LIKE '%cobalamin%'
    )
    AND (
      LOWER(tg.description) LIKE '%absorption%' OR
      LOWER(tg.description) LIKE '%intestinal%' OR
      LOWER(tg.description) LIKE '%gastrointestinal%'
    )

  UNION

  -- GO molecular function term for related human carrier(s) indicating hormone interaction
  SELECT
    c.parent_key AS d_id,
    NULL AS transporter_name,
    cg.description AS carrier_hormone_go_function
  FROM "drugbank_carriers" c
  JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides_go" cg
    ON cg.parent_key = c.id
  WHERE c.parent_key = ?
    AND c.organism = 'Humans'
    AND cg.category = 'function'
    AND LOWER(cg.description) LIKE '%hormone%'
) q
GROUP BY d_id
LIMIT 50;

WITH enbrel_price AS (

  FROM "drugbank_drug_prices"

  WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%fda label%'
  GROUP BY parent_key

  e.cost,
  COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS fda_label_attachments,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE e.cost * 1.0 / a.cnt END AS usd_cost_per_fda_label_attachment
FROM enbrel_price e
LEFT JOIN fda_att a ON a.parent_key = e.parent_key
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT tp.gene_name
     FROM "drugbank_carriers" c
     LEFT JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" tp
       ON tp.name = c.name AND tp.organism LIKE 'Humans%'
     WHERE c.name = 'Thyroxine-binding globulin' AND c.organism = 'Humans'
     LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT dse.gene_symbol
     FROM "drugbank_drug_snp_effects" dse
     WHERE dse.protein_name LIKE '%Thyroxine-binding globulin%'
     LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT sar.gene_symbol
     FROM "drugbank_snp_adverse_reactions" sar
     WHERE sar.protein_name LIKE '%Thyroxine-binding globulin%'
     LIMIT 1)
  ) AS human_gene_for_main_thyroid_hormone_transport_protein,
  d.title AS reference_database,
  d.ref_id AS example_identifier
FROM
  (SELECT 1) AS t
CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT dl.title, dl.ref_id
   FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" ds
   JOIN "drugbank_drugs_links" dl ON dl.parent_key = ds.drugbank_id
   WHERE ds.synonym = 'Methotrexate'
   LIMIT 1) AS d
LIMIT 50;

WITH
input_polypeptide AS (
  -- Set the carrier polypeptide you care about here (example: Transcobalamin-2)
  SELECT 'Transcobalamin-2' AS polypeptide_query
),
vitamin_binding_annotation AS (
  -- Heuristic: fetch vitamin-related binding/functional annotations for the given carrier polypeptide
  SELECT
    'vitamin_binding_annotation' AS section,
    cp.name AS entity,
    COALESCE(cp.specific_function, cp.general_function) AS details
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" cp
  JOIN input_polypeptide i
    ON lower(cp.name) LIKE '%' || lower(i.polypeptide_query) || '%'
  WHERE lower(COALESCE(cp.specific_function, '')) LIKE '%vitamin%'
     OR lower(COALESCE(cp.general_function, '')) LIKE '%vitamin%'
),

    dl.title AS entity,
    dfi.food_interaction AS details
  FROM "drugbank_drug_food_interactions" dfi
  JOIN "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
    ON dl.parent_key = dfi.drugbank_id
  WHERE lower(dl.title) LIKE '%biotin%'
    AND lower(dfi.food_interaction) LIKE '%avidin%'

SELECT s.drugbank_id, a.pubmed_id
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE LOWER(synonym) = 'dornasa alfa'
    AND LOWER(language) LIKE '%spanish%'
  LIMIT 1
) AS s
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT pubmed_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_carriers_articles"
  WHERE LOWER(citation) LIKE '%albumin diffusion%'
    AND LOWER(citation) LIKE '%rabbit%'
    AND LOWER(citation) LIKE '%mesenter%'
  LIMIT 1
) AS a
LIMIT 50;

SELECT DISTINCT

  tp.gene_name AS gene_symbol,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(tp.specific_function), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(tp.general_function), '')) AS substances_carried
FROM "drugbank_transporters" AS t
JOIN "drugbank_transporters_actions" AS ta
  ON ta.parent_id = t.id
JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" AS tp
  ON tp.parent_id = t.id
WHERE ta.action = 'substrate'
  AND (tp.organism = 'Humans' OR t.organism = 'Humans')
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(tp.specific_function), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(tp.general_function), '')) IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 50;

WITH textbook AS (
  SELECT
    isbn
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_textbooks"
  WHERE
    LOWER(citation) LIKE '%stockley%'            -- e.g., "Stockley’s Drug Interactions"
    OR LOWER(citation) LIKE '%drug interaction%'  -- generic match for drug–drug interaction references
    OR LOWER(citation) LIKE '%hansten%'           -- e.g., "Hansten & Horn's Drug Interactions"
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(citation) LIKE '%stockley%' THEN 1
      WHEN LOWER(citation) LIKE '%drug interaction%' THEN 2
      WHEN LOWER(citation) LIKE '%hansten%' THEN 3
      ELSE 4
    END
  LIMIT 1
),
mfr AS (
  SELECT
    title AS generic_manufacturer
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE parent_key = 'DB00035'
    AND (
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%manufacturer%'
      OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%generic%'
      OR LOWER(url) LIKE '%manufacturer%'
      OR LOWER(url) LIKE '%generic%'
    )
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  t.isbn AS textbook_isbn,
  m.generic_manufacturer
FROM textbook t
LEFT JOIN mfr m ON 1=1
LIMIT 50;

  FROM action_counts
  GROUP BY parent_key

top_action AS (
  SELECT ac.parent_key, ac.known_action

  ON ta.parent_key = d.drugbank_id

SELECT
  dl.title AS combination_title,
  dl.ref_id AS drugs_links_ref_id,
  dcl.ref_id AS carriers_links_ref_id
FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" AS dl
JOIN "drugbank_drug_carriers_links" AS dcl
  ON dl.parent_key = dcl.parent_key
WHERE
  LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%monograph%'
  AND LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%monograph%'
  AND (dl.title LIKE '%/%' OR dcl.title LIKE '%/%')  -- heuristic for fixed-dose combinations
  AND (
    LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%hydrochlorothiazide%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%hydrochlorothiazide%'
    OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%amlodipine%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%amlodipine%'
    OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%valsartan%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%valsartan%'
    OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%irbesartan%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%irbesartan%'
    OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%losartan%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%losartan%'
    OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%telmisartan%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%telmisartan%'
    OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%candesartan%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%candesartan%'
    OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%olmesartan%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%olmesartan%'
    OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%aliskiren%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%aliskiren%'
    OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%benazepril%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%benazepril%'
    OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%enalapril%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%enalapril%'
    OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%lisinopril%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%lisinopril%'
    OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%chlorthalidone%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%chlorthalidone%'
    OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%atenolol%' OR LOWER(dcl.title) LIKE '%atenolol%'
  )
GROUP BY dl.parent_key
ORDER BY combination_title
LIMIT 50;

WITH action_counts AS (
  SELECT LOWER(action) AS action, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_actions"
  WHERE LOWER(action) NOT IN ('binder')
    AND LOWER(action) NOT LIKE '%substrate%'
    AND LOWER(action) NOT LIKE '%carrier%'
  GROUP BY LOWER(action)
),
selected_action AS (
  SELECT action
  FROM action_counts
  ORDER BY cnt DESC, action ASC
  LIMIT 1

target_org AS (
  SELECT parent_key, organism, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM "drugbank_targets"
  WHERE parent_key BETWEEN 'DB00001' AND 'DB00020'
  GROUP BY parent_key, organism
),
pick_org AS (
  SELECT
    parent_key,
    organism,
    cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_key ORDER BY cnt DESC, organism ASC) AS rn
  FROM target_org
),
selected_org AS (
  SELECT parent_key, organism
  FROM pick_org
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 'carrier_non_transport_action' AS item, action AS value1, NULL AS value2
FROM selected_action
UNION ALL
SELECT 'drug_affected_organism' AS item, parent_key AS value1, organism AS value2
FROM selected_org
ORDER BY item, value1
LIMIT 50;

WITH t0 AS (
  SELECT
    parent_key,
    citation,
    substr(citation, instr(citation, '). ') + 3) AS after_year
  FROM "drugbank_drug_carriers_textbooks"

  LIMIT 1

textbook AS (
  SELECT
    parent_key,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(citation, '). ') > 0 THEN
        trim(substr(after_year, 1, CASE WHEN instr(after_year, '.') > 0 THEN instr(after_year, '.') - 1 ELSE length(after_year) END))
      ELSE
        trim(substr(citation, 1, CASE WHEN instr(citation, '.') > 0 THEN instr(citation, '.') - 1 ELSE length(citation) END))

  FROM t0
),

  WHERE parent_key = 'BE0000703'
    AND (lower(citation) LIKE '%bile salt export pump%' OR lower(citation) LIKE '%bsep%')

  ORDER BY pubmed_id

  t.name AS transporter_name,
  pp.cellular_location
FROM "drugbank_transporters" AS t
JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" AS pp
  ON pp.parent_id = t.id
WHERE
  t.parent_key = :drugbank_id
  AND pp.organism = 'Humans'
  AND LOWER(pp.specific_function) LIKE '%cisplatin transporter%'
ORDER BY transporter_name
LIMIT 50;

WITH oct AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE lower(synonym) = 'octreotide'
  LIMIT 1
),
salts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.drugbank_id, s.synonym AS salt_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  WHERE lower(s.synonym) LIKE '%octreotide%'
    AND (
      lower(s.synonym) LIKE '%acetate%' OR
      lower(s.synonym) LIKE '%hydrochloride%' OR
      lower(s.synonym) LIKE '%sulfate%' OR
      lower(s.synonym) LIKE '%phosphate%' OR
      lower(s.synonym) LIKE '%mesylate%' OR
      lower(s.synonym) LIKE '%nitrate%' OR
      lower(s.synonym) LIKE '%bromide%' OR
      lower(s.synonym) LIKE '%tartrate%' OR
      lower(s.synonym) LIKE '%maleate%' OR
      lower(s.synonym) LIKE '%succinate%' OR
      lower(s.synonym) LIKE '%citrate%'
    )
),
salt_masses AS (
  SELECT sl.drugbank_id,
         MIN(sl.salt_name) AS salt_name,
         MAX(CAST(REPLACE(ep.value, ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS average_mass
  FROM salts sl
  LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drug_experimental_properties" ep
    ON ep.parent_key = sl.drugbank_id
   AND lower(ep.kind) = 'average mass'
  GROUP BY sl.drugbank_id
),
base_mass AS (
  SELECT o.drugbank_id AS drugbank_id,
         'Base (no salt specified)' AS salt_name,
         MAX(CAST(REPLACE(ep.value, ',', '') AS FLOAT)) AS average_mass
  FROM oct o
  LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drug_experimental_properties" ep
    ON ep.parent_key = o.drugbank_id
   AND lower(ep.kind) = 'average mass'
  GROUP BY o.drugbank_id
),
all_masses AS (
  SELECT * FROM salt_masses
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM base_mass
)
SELECT (SELECT drugbank_id FROM oct) AS octreotide_drugbank_id,
       salt_name,
       average_mass,
       CASE WHEN average_mass = (SELECT MAX(average_mass) FROM all_masses) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_highest_average_mass
FROM all_masses
ORDER BY is_highest_average_mass DESC, average_mass DESC, salt_name
LIMIT 50;

WITH reg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key AS drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE
    LOWER(title) LIKE '%label%' OR
    LOWER(title) LIKE '%monograph%' OR
    LOWER(url)   LIKE '%label%' OR
    LOWER(url)   LIKE '%monograph%'
),
ped_patent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key AS drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE
    (
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%patent%' OR
      LOWER(url)   LIKE '%patent%' OR
      LOWER(url)   LIKE '%uspto.gov%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%orange book%'
    )
    AND
    (
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%pediatric%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%paediatric%' OR
      LOWER(url)   LIKE '%pediatric%' OR
      LOWER(url)   LIKE '%paediatric%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%exclusiv%' OR
      LOWER(url)   LIKE '%exclusiv%'
    )
    AND
    (
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%fda%' OR
      LOWER(url)   LIKE '%fda%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%united states%' OR
      LOWER(url)   LIKE '%uspto.gov%' OR
      LOWER(url)   LIKE '%.gov%'
    )
),
hits AS (
  SELECT r.drugbank_id
  FROM reg r
  INNER JOIN ped_patent p ON p.drugbank_id = r.drugbank_id
)
SELECT
  h.drugbank_id,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT s1.synonym
      FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s1
      WHERE s1.drugbank_id = h.drugbank_id
        AND LOWER(s1.language) LIKE '%english%'
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN LOWER(s1.coder) LIKE '%inn%' OR LOWER(s1.coder) LIKE '%usan%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        s1.synonym
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    (
      SELECT s2.synonym
      FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s2
      WHERE s2.drugbank_id = h.drugbank_id
      ORDER BY s2.synonym
      LIMIT 1
    )
  ) AS preferred_name,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
    WHERE l.parent_key = h.drugbank_id
      AND (
        LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%label%' OR
        LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%monograph%' OR
        LOWER(l.url)   LIKE '%label%' OR
        LOWER(l.url)   LIKE '%monograph%'
      )
  ) AS reg_link_count,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
    WHERE l.parent_key = h.drugbank_id
      AND (
        (LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%patent%' OR
         LOWER(l.url)   LIKE '%patent%' OR
         LOWER(l.url)   LIKE '%uspto.gov%' OR
         LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%orange book%')
        AND
        (LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%pediatric%' OR
         LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%paediatric%' OR
         LOWER(l.url)   LIKE '%pediatric%' OR
         LOWER(l.url)   LIKE '%paediatric%' OR
         LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%exclusiv%' OR
         LOWER(l.url)   LIKE '%exclusiv%')
        AND
        (LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%fda%' OR
         LOWER(l.url)   LIKE '%fda%' OR
         LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%united states%' OR
         LOWER(l.url)   LIKE '%uspto.gov%' OR
         LOWER(l.url)   LIKE '%.gov%')
      )
  ) AS ped_patent_link_count
FROM hits h
ORDER BY h.drugbank_id
LIMIT 50;

WITH fda_label AS (
  SELECT
    title,
    url
  FROM "drugbank_drug_trans_links"
  WHERE (title LIKE '%Cyclosporin%Label%' OR (title LIKE '%Cyclosporin%' AND url LIKE '%drugsatfda%'))
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN title LIKE '%Product Label%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, title
  LIMIT 1
),
study_candidates AS (
  SELECT title, url FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT title, url FROM "drugbank_drug_trans_links"
),
study AS (
  SELECT
    title,
    url,
    CASE
      WHEN url LIKE '%pubmed%' AND instr(url, 'pubmed/') > 0 THEN
        CASE
          WHEN instr(substr(url, instr(url,'pubmed/')+7), '/') > 0
            THEN substr(url, instr(url,'pubmed/')+7, instr(substr(url, instr(url,'pubmed/')+7), '/') - 1)
          ELSE substr(url, instr(url,'pubmed/')+7)
        END
      ELSE NULL
    END AS pubmed_id
  FROM study_candidates
  WHERE (title LIKE '%P-glycoprotein%' OR title LIKE '%P-gp%')
    AND (title LIKE '%interpatient%' OR title LIKE '%inter-patient%')
    AND title LIKE '%bioavailability%'
    AND (title LIKE '%Cyclosporin%' OR title LIKE '%Cyclosporine%')
  ORDER BY title
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  fda_label.title AS fda_label_title,
  fda_label.url AS fda_label_url,
  study.pubmed_id AS study_pubmed_id
FROM fda_label
CROSS JOIN study
LIMIT 50;

WITH results AS (
  SELECT
    'alteplase_action_pathway_id' AS item,
    ref_id AS identifier,
    title,
    url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE
    lower(title) LIKE '%alteplase action pathway%'
    OR (lower(title) LIKE '%action pathway%' AND lower(url) LIKE '%alteplase%')

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'oatp_pfam_id' AS item,
    CASE
      WHEN ref_id LIKE 'PF%' THEN ref_id
      WHEN lower(url) LIKE '%pfam.xfam.org/family/%' THEN substr(url, instr(lower(url), 'family/') + 7)
      ELSE ref_id
    END AS identifier,
    title,
    url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE
    lower(title) LIKE '%pfam%'
    AND (
      lower(title) LIKE '%oatp%'
      OR lower(title) LIKE '%organic anion transporting polypeptide%'
      OR lower(url) LIKE '%oatp%'
      OR lower(url) LIKE '%pf03169%'
      OR lower(url) LIKE '%slco%'
    )
)
SELECT * FROM results
LIMIT 50;

WITH sd AS (

  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" ds
  WHERE lower(ds.synonym) = lower(:drug)

SELECT
  sd.drugbank_id AS drugbank_id,
  c.name AS primary_human_carrier,
  (
    SELECT dl.title
    FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
    WHERE dl.parent_key = sd.drugbank_id
      AND (
        lower(dl.title) LIKE '%textbook%' OR
        lower(dl.title) LIKE '%pharmacology%' OR
        lower(dl.url)   LIKE '%bookshelf%' OR
        lower(dl.url)   LIKE '%textbook%'

    ORDER BY dl.title
    LIMIT 1

  (
    SELECT dl.url
    FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
    WHERE dl.parent_key = sd.drugbank_id
      AND (
        lower(dl.title) LIKE '%textbook%' OR
        lower(dl.title) LIKE '%pharmacology%' OR
        lower(dl.url)   LIKE '%bookshelf%' OR
        lower(dl.url)   LIKE '%textbook%'
      )
    ORDER BY dl.title
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS textbook_url,
  (
    SELECT dl.ref_id
    FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
    WHERE dl.parent_key = sd.drugbank_id
      AND (
        lower(dl.title) LIKE '%textbook%' OR
        lower(dl.title) LIKE '%pharmacology%' OR

FROM sd

WITH labels AS (
  SELECT
    parent_key AS drugbank_id,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(url, '/20') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(url, instr(url, '/20') + 1, 4) AS INT)
      WHEN instr(url, '/19') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(url, instr(url, '/19') + 1, 4) AS INT)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS label_year
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE url LIKE '%/label/%'
),
first_label AS (
  SELECT
    drugbank_id,
    MIN(label_year) AS label_year
  FROM labels
  WHERE label_year IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY drugbank_id
),
patents AS (
  SELECT
    parent_key AS drugbank_id,
    number AS patent_number,
    expires,
    pediatric_extension
  FROM "drugbank_drug_patents"
)
SELECT
  p.drugbank_id,
  p.patent_number,
  f.label_year AS labeling_year,
  CAST(strftime('%Y',
       date(p.expires,
            CASE
              WHEN p.pediatric_extension IN (1, '1', 't', 'T', 'true', 'True', 'TRUE') THEN '+6 months'
              ELSE '+0 months'
            END)
      ) AS INT) AS expiry_year_incl_ped_ext,
  CAST(strftime('%Y',
       date(p.expires,
            CASE
              WHEN p.pediatric_extension IN (1, '1', 't', 'T', 'true', 'True', 'TRUE') THEN '+6 months'
              ELSE '+0 months'
            END)
      ) AS INT) - f.label_year AS years_separating
FROM patents p
JOIN first_label f ON f.drugbank_id = p.drugbank_id
WHERE f.label_year IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 50;

WITH target_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key, title AS substance
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE LOWER(title) IN ('celecoxib','caffeine')

  WHERE citation LIKE '%StatPearls%' AND citation LIKE '%Celecoxib%'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key, 'Caffeine' AS substance
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_textbooks"
  WHERE citation LIKE '%StatPearls%' AND citation LIKE '%Caffeine%'
)
SELECT
  td.substance,
  dt.ref_id,
  dt.parent_key,
  CASE WHEN dt.isbn IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(dt.isbn) <> '' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS includes_isbn
FROM "drugbank_drugs_textbooks" dt
JOIN target_drugs td ON dt.parent_key = td.parent_key
WHERE dt.citation LIKE '%StatPearls%'
ORDER BY td.substance, dt.ref_id
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  d.drugbank_id AS cetuximab_drugbank_id,
  c.name AS carrier_name,
  tp.gene_name AS carrier_gene_name
FROM
  (SELECT drugbank_id
   FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
   WHERE LOWER(synonym) = 'cetuximab' AND LOWER(coder) = 'inn/usan'
   LIMIT 1) AS d
CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT name
   FROM "drugbank_carriers"
   WHERE organism = 'Humans' AND LOWER(name) LIKE '%serum albumin%'
   LIMIT 1) AS c
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT gene_name
   FROM "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides"
   WHERE organism = 'Humans' AND LOWER(name) LIKE '%albumin%'
   LIMIT 1) AS tp
LIMIT 50;

WITH enzyme_actions AS (
  SELECT
    LOWER(known_action) AS interaction_type,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM "drugbank_targets"
  WHERE (LOWER(name) LIKE '%cytochrome p450%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%cyp%')
    AND known_action IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(LOWER(known_action)) NOT IN ('', 'unknown')
  GROUP BY LOWER(known_action)
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
grapefruit_pubmed AS (
  SELECT
    ref_id AS pubmed_id,
    title,
    url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE url LIKE '%pubmed%'
    AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%grapefruit%'
    AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%activat%'
    AND (
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%p-glycoprotein%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%p glycoprotein%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%p-gp%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%pgp%'
    )
  ORDER BY pubmed_id
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT interaction_type FROM enzyme_actions) AS most_common_enzyme_interaction_type,
  (SELECT pubmed_id FROM grapefruit_pubmed) AS grapefruit_pgp_pubmed_id,
  (SELECT title FROM grapefruit_pubmed) AS grapefruit_pgp_pubmed_title

WITH enzymes_both AS (
  SELECT id, name
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes"
  GROUP BY id, name
  HAVING SUM(
           CASE
             WHEN inhibition_strength IS NOT NULL
                  AND LOWER(TRIM(CAST(inhibition_strength AS TEXT))) NOT IN ('', 'unknown', 'n/a')
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         ) > 0
     AND SUM(
           CASE
             WHEN induction_strength IS NOT NULL

             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         ) > 0
),
ddi_increased_metabolism AS (

  FROM "drugbank_query_ddi_table"
  WHERE LOWER(interaction) LIKE '%metabolism of%increase%'
     OR LOWER(interaction) LIKE '%increase%metabol%'
     OR LOWER(interaction) LIKE '%increased metabolism%'
)
SELECT 'enzyme' AS result_type, id AS value1, name AS value2, NULL AS value3
FROM enzymes_both
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ddi' AS result_type, drug1, drug2, interaction
FROM ddi_increased_metabolism
LIMIT 50;

WITH drug_names AS (
  SELECT left_drugbank_id AS drug_id, left_drugbank_name AS drug_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  UNION
  SELECT right_drugbank_id AS drug_id, right_drugbank_name AS drug_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"

  COALESCE(MAX(dn.drug_name), MAX(dl.title)) AS drug_name,

WHERE LOWER(dt.citation) LIKE '%vitamin d: basic and clinical aspects%'
   OR LOWER(dt.citation) LIKE '%rajiv kumar%'
   OR dt.citation LIKE '%1984%'
GROUP BY dt.parent_key
LIMIT 50;

    t.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
    t.name AS target_name,
    t.known_action,

WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidates);

  l.ref_id,

JOIN "drugbank_drugs_links" AS l

ORDER BY drug_name, l.title

  c.gene_name,

LIMIT 50;

FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" cp
JOIN "drugbank_carriers" c
  ON c.id = cp.parent_id
JOIN "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  ON l.parent_key = c.parent_key

FROM counts

  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"

duplicated_ref AS (

  COUNT(DISTINCT a.atc_code) AS atc_code_count,

JOIN "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" cp

GROUP BY c.parent_key

WITH links AS (
  SELECT ref_id, title, url, parent_key FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ref_id, title, url, parent_key FROM "drugbank_drug_targ_links"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ref_id, title, url, parent_key FROM "drugbank_drug_carriers_links"
),
fluvox AS (
  SELECT ref_id, parent_key
  FROM links
  WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%fda%label%fluvoxamine%'
  LIMIT 1
),
patent_links AS (
  SELECT l.title, l.url
  FROM links l
  JOIN fluvox f ON l.parent_key = f.parent_key
  WHERE lower(l.title) LIKE '%patent%'
    AND lower(l.title) LIKE '%pediatric%'
    AND (
      lower(l.title) LIKE '%u.s.%' OR
      lower(l.title) LIKE '%united states%' OR
      lower(l.title) LIKE '%us %' OR
      lower(l.title) LIKE '%united states patent%'
    )
  ORDER BY l.title ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  f.ref_id AS reference_identifier,
  p.title AS pediatric_us_patent_reference_title,
  p.url AS pediatric_us_patent_reference_url
FROM fluvox f
LEFT JOIN patent_links p ON 1=1
LIMIT 50;

WITH cetux AS (

  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE LOWER(synonym) = 'cetuximab'
  LIMIT 1

tgt AS (
  SELECT id, name, parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_targets"
  WHERE parent_key = (SELECT dbid FROM cetux)
    AND known_action = 'yes'
  ORDER BY COALESCE(position, 9999)
  LIMIT 1
),
path AS (
  SELECT name AS pathway_name, parent_key

  WHERE parent_key = (SELECT dbid FROM cetux)

  ORDER BY name
  LIMIT 1
),
snp AS (
  SELECT gene_symbol
  FROM "drugbank_drug_snp_effects"
  WHERE parent_key = (SELECT dbid FROM cetux)
    AND gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND gene_symbol <> ''
    AND (
      gene_symbol IN ('EGFR','ERBB1')
      OR protein_name LIKE (SELECT '%' || name || '%' FROM tgt)
      OR (SELECT name FROM tgt) LIKE '%' || protein_name || '%'
    )
  LIMIT 1

SELECT
  path.pathway_name AS pathway_name,
  tgt.name AS target_name,
  COALESCE(
    snp.gene_symbol,
    CASE
      WHEN tgt.name LIKE 'Epidermal growth factor receptor%' THEN 'EGFR'
      WHEN tgt.name LIKE '%Fc region receptor III-B%' THEN 'FCGR3B'

FROM path
CROSS JOIN tgt

WITH metformin AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE lower(synonym) = 'metformin'
),
fda_label AS (
  SELECT l.ref_id
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  JOIN metformin m ON l.parent_key = m.drugbank_id
  WHERE (lower(l.title) LIKE '%fda%' AND lower(l.title) LIKE '%label%')
     OR (lower(l.url) LIKE '%fda%' AND lower(l.url) LIKE '%label%')
  LIMIT 1
),
gsk_international_brands AS (
  SELECT b.brand, b.company
  FROM "drugbank_drug_international_brands" b
  JOIN metformin m ON b.drugbank_id = m.drugbank_id

      FROM "drugbank_drug_manufacturers" mf
      WHERE mf.drugbank_id = m.drugbank_id
        AND lower(mf.manufacturer) LIKE '%glaxosmithkline%'
    )
)
SELECT f.ref_id AS fda_label_ref_id,
       g.brand AS gsk_brand,
       g.company AS gsk_company
FROM fda_label f
CROSS JOIN gsk_international_brands g

WITH candidate_drugs AS (
  SELECT
    p.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
    CAST(p.value AS REAL) AS isoelectric_point
  FROM "drugbank_drug_experimental_properties" p
  JOIN "drugbank_targets" t
    ON t.parent_key = p.parent_key
  WHERE
    p.kind = 'Isoelectric Point'
    AND p.value GLOB '*[0-9]*'
    AND t.organism = 'Humans'
    AND t.known_action = 'yes'
    AND (
      UPPER(t.name) LIKE '%THROMBIN%'
      OR UPPER(t.name) LIKE '%PROTHROMBIN%'
      OR UPPER(t.name) LIKE '%COAGULATION FACTOR%'
      OR UPPER(t.name) LIKE '%PLASMIN%'
      OR UPPER(t.name) LIKE '%PLASMINOGEN%'
      OR UPPER(t.name) LIKE '%PLASMINOGEN ACTIVATOR%'
      OR UPPER(t.name) LIKE '%UROKINASE%'
      OR UPPER(t.name) LIKE '%KALLIKREIN%'
    )
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    drugbank_id,
    MIN(isoelectric_point) AS isoelectric_point
  FROM candidate_drugs
  GROUP BY drugbank_id
)
SELECT
  drugbank_id,
  isoelectric_point
FROM agg
ORDER BY isoelectric_point ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH d AS (

  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"

t AS (
  SELECT t.*
  FROM "drugbank_targets" t
  JOIN d ON t.parent_key = d.drug_id
),
go_scored AS (
  SELECT
    g.parent_key,
    g.category,
    g.description,
    /* Oxidative activity signals */
    (
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%peroxid%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%oxidoreduct%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '% oxid%' ESCAPE '\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%reactive oxygen species%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%hydrogen peroxide%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%superoxide%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%respiratory burst%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS oxid_score,
    /* Antimicrobial/antibacterial signals */
    (
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%antimicrob%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%antibacter%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%antifung%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%defense response to bacter%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%bacteri%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%fung%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%microbicid%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN lower(g.description) LIKE '%killing of%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS am_score
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides_go" g
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  d.drug_id,
  d.drug_name,
  t.organism AS affected_organism_group,
  t.name AS enzyme_target_name,
  go.category AS go_category,
  go.description AS go_term,
  (go.oxid_score * 2 + go.am_score) AS relevance_score
FROM d
JOIN t ON 1=1
JOIN go_scored go ON go.parent_key = t.id
WHERE go.category IN ('function','process')
  AND (go.oxid_score > 0 OR go.am_score > 0)
ORDER BY go.oxid_score DESC, go.am_score DESC, go.category, go.description
LIMIT 50;

WITH tnf_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_targets"
  WHERE organism = 'Humans'
    AND known_action = 'yes'
    AND LOWER(name) LIKE '%tumor necrosis factor%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  d.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  s.synonym AS drug_name,
  l.title AS link_title,
  l.url AS link_url
FROM tnf_drugs d
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  ON s.drugbank_id = d.parent_key
 AND s.language LIKE 'english%'
 AND (s.coder LIKE '%inn%' OR s.coder LIKE '%usan%')
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  ON l.parent_key = d.parent_key
WHERE l.title LIKE '%Manufactur%'
   OR l.title LIKE '%Packag%'
   OR l.title LIKE '%Company%'
   OR l.title LIKE '%Labeler%'
   OR l.title LIKE '%Sponsor%'
ORDER BY drugbank_id, link_title
LIMIT 50;

WITH study AS (
  SELECT
    ref_id AS pubmed_id,
    title,
    url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE (title LIKE '%paroxetine%' AND title LIKE '%methadone%')
     OR (url LIKE '%ncbi.nlm.nih.gov%' AND title LIKE '%paroxetine%' AND title LIKE '%methadone%')
  LIMIT 1
),
transporter_dual AS (
  SELECT
    name,
    organism
  FROM (
    SELECT
      name,
      organism,
      SUM(CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(known_action,'')) LIKE '%substrate%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS substrate_count,
      SUM(CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(known_action,'')) LIKE '%inhibitor%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inhibitor_count
    FROM "drugbank_transporters"
    GROUP BY name, organism
  )
  WHERE substrate_count > 0 AND inhibitor_count > 0
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  'study' AS result_type,
  pubmed_id AS id,
  title AS name_or_title,
  url AS details
FROM study
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'transporter' AS result_type,
  NULL AS id,
  name AS name_or_title,
  'annotated as both substrate and inhibitor (' || organism || ')' AS details
FROM transporter_dual
LIMIT 50;

WITH wilson AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT isbn AS wilson_2016_isbn
  FROM (
    SELECT isbn, citation FROM "drugbank_drug_trans_textbooks"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT isbn, citation FROM "drugbank_drugs_textbooks"
  ) t
  WHERE t.citation LIKE '%Wilson%' AND t.citation LIKE '%2016%' AND t.citation LIKE '%predictive drug metabolism%'
),
ahfs_mentions AS (
  SELECT parent_key AS drugbank_id, title AS mention
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE title LIKE '%AHFS%' OR url LIKE '%ahfs%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT parent_key AS drugbank_id, citation AS mention
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_textbooks"
  WHERE citation LIKE '%AHFS%'
),
two_plus AS (
  SELECT drugbank_id
  FROM ahfs_mentions
  GROUP BY drugbank_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mention) >= 2
),
codes AS (
  SELECT a.drugbank_id,
         MIN(a.mention) AS ahfs_code_1,
         MAX(a.mention) AS ahfs_code_2
  FROM ahfs_mentions a
  JOIN two_plus t ON t.drugbank_id = a.drugbank_id
  GROUP BY a.drugbank_id
)
SELECT c.drugbank_id,
       c.ahfs_code_1,
       c.ahfs_code_2,
       w.wilson_2016_isbn
FROM codes c
LEFT JOIN wilson w ON 1=1
LIMIT 50;

  p.name AS transporter_name,
  p.gene_name AS gene_symbol,
  g.description AS go_biological_process_term
FROM "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" p
JOIN "drugbank_transporters" t
  ON t.id = p.parent_id
JOIN (
  SELECT description
  FROM "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides_go"
  WHERE lower(category) = 'process'
    AND lower(description) LIKE '%thyroid hormone%'
    AND lower(description) LIKE '%transport%'
  LIMIT 1
) g
WHERE lower(COALESCE(p.specific_function,'')) LIKE '%thyroxine%'
  AND lower(COALESCE(p.specific_function,'')) LIKE '%triiodothyronine%'
  AND lower(COALESCE(p.cellular_location,'')) LIKE '%basolateral%'
  AND lower(p.organism) = 'humans'
LIMIT 50;

  SELECT parent_key AS enzyme_parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drug_enzymes_links"
  WHERE title IN ('Peg-interferon alfa-2b FDA label', 'Fluvoxamine FDA label')

hormone_go AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cpg.parent_key AS carrier_parent_key,
         cpg.description AS hormone_go_description
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_go" cpg
  JOIN "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_syn" cps
    ON cps.parent_key = cpg.parent_key
  WHERE LOWER(cps.text) IN ('serpin a7','t4-binding globulin','tbg')
    AND LOWER(cpg.category) LIKE '%function%'
    AND LOWER(cpg.description) LIKE '%hormone%'
)
SELECT e.enzyme_parent_key,
       h.hormone_go_description
FROM enzymes e
CROSS JOIN hormone_go h
LIMIT 50;

WITH candidate_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_snp_adverse_reactions"
  WHERE gene_symbol = 'TPMT'
    AND (description LIKE '%TPMT*3A%' OR description LIKE '%*3A%')
    AND (description LIKE '%bone marrow%' OR description LIKE '%myelosup%')
),
drug_names AS (
  SELECT
    ds.drugbank_id AS parent_key,
    ds.synonym AS drug_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ds.drugbank_id
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN ds.coder LIKE '%inn%' OR ds.coder LIKE '%usan%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        ds.language
    ) AS rn
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" ds
  WHERE ds.drugbank_id IN (SELECT parent_key FROM candidate_drugs)
    AND ds.language LIKE '%english%'
)
SELECT
  dn.drug_name,
  MIN(tpp.molecular_weight) AS molecular_weight
FROM candidate_drugs cd
LEFT JOIN drug_names dn
  ON dn.parent_key = cd.parent_key AND dn.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_transporters" tr
  ON tr.parent_key = cd.parent_key
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" tpp
  ON tpp.parent_id = tr.id
GROUP BY dn.drug_name

WITH gene AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT gene_name
  FROM "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides"
  WHERE lower(coalesce(cellular_location, '')) LIKE '%secreted%'
    AND (
      (lower(coalesce(general_function, '')) LIKE '%bind%' AND lower(coalesce(general_function, '')) LIKE '%drug%')
      OR
      (lower(coalesce(specific_function, '')) LIKE '%bind%' AND lower(coalesce(specific_function, '')) LIKE '%drug%')
    )
    AND (
      lower(coalesce(general_function, '')) LIKE '%distribution%'
      OR lower(coalesce(specific_function, '')) LIKE '%distribution%'
    )
  ORDER BY gene_name
  LIMIT 1
),
fda AS (
  SELECT ref_id
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE parent_key IN (
    SELECT drugbank_id
    FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
    WHERE lower(synonym) LIKE 'cetirizine%'
  )
    AND (
      (lower(coalesce(title, '')) LIKE '%fda%' AND lower(coalesce(title, '')) LIKE '%label%')
      OR lower(coalesce(title, '')) LIKE '%dailymed%'
      OR lower(coalesce(url, '')) LIKE '%dailymed%'
    )
  ORDER BY ref_id
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT gene.gene_name AS gene_name_of_secreted_transport_protein,
       fda.ref_id AS cetirizine_fda_label_ref_id
FROM gene
CROSS JOIN fda
LIMIT 50;

  CASE WHEN COUNT(a.action) > 0 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS has_recorded_action,

  trans.name AS mdr1_transporter_name
FROM
  (

      SELECT ds.drugbank_id
      FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" ds
      WHERE LOWER(ds.synonym) IN ('prozac', 'fluoxetine')

    JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" p

      OR LOWER(p.name) LIKE '%mdr1%'

SELECT
  t.id AS transporter_id,
  t.name AS transporter_name,
  l.title AS textbook_title,
  l.url AS textbook_url,
  CASE
    WHEN instr(lower(l.url), 'isbn=') > 0 THEN
      CASE
        WHEN instr(substr(l.url, instr(lower(l.url), 'isbn=') + 5), '&') > 0 THEN
          substr(
            l.url,
            instr(lower(l.url), 'isbn=') + 5,
            instr(substr(l.url, instr(lower(l.url), 'isbn=') + 5), '&') - 1

      END

FROM "drugbank_transporters" AS t
JOIN (
  SELECT parent_id
  FROM "drugbank_transporters_actions"
  WHERE action IN ('substrate', 'inhibitor')
  GROUP BY parent_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT action) = 2
) AS both_actions
  ON both_actions.parent_id = t.id
JOIN "drugbank_drugs_links" AS l
  ON l.parent_key = t.id
WHERE upper(l.title) LIKE '%ISBN%' OR lower(l.url) LIKE '%isbn%'
LIMIT 50;

WITH xolair_ema AS (
  SELECT title
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE (lower(title) LIKE '%xolair%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%xolair%')
    AND (lower(title) LIKE '%ema%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%ema.europa.eu%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%epar%')
  ORDER BY title
  LIMIT 1
),
go_terms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT description
  FROM (
    SELECT category, description FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_go"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT category, description FROM "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides_go"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT category, description FROM "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides_go"
  ) AS go
  WHERE lower(go.category) LIKE '%function%'
    AND lower(go.description) LIKE '%hormone%'
    AND lower(go.description) LIKE '%binding%'
  ORDER BY description
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT x.title AS ema_label_title, g.description AS go_molecular_function_term
FROM xolair_ema x
CROSS JOIN go_terms g
LIMIT 50;

  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"

calcium_pairs AS (
