WITH links AS (
  SELECT '"drugbank_drugs_links"' AS src, ref_id, title, url FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '"drugbank_drug_carriers_links"' AS src, ref_id, title, url FROM "drugbank_drug_carriers_links"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '"drugbank_drug_trans_links"' AS src, ref_id, title, url FROM "drugbank_drug_trans_links"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN lower(title) LIKE '%ranolazine%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%ranolazine%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%ranexa%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%ranexa%' THEN 'ranolazine'
    WHEN lower(title) LIKE '%prazosin%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%prazosin%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%minipress%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%minipress%' THEN 'prazosin'
  END AS drug,
  ref_id,
  substr(
    CASE
      WHEN instr(url, '://') > 0 THEN substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3)
      ELSE url
    END,
    1,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(
        CASE
          WHEN instr(url, '://') > 0 THEN substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3)
          ELSE url
        END,
        '/'
      ) - 1 > 0
      THEN instr(
        CASE
          WHEN instr(url, '://') > 0 THEN substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3)
          ELSE url
        END,
        '/'
      ) - 1
      ELSE length(
        CASE
          WHEN instr(url, '://') > 0 THEN substr(url, instr(url, '://') + 3)
          ELSE url
        END
      )
    END
  ) AS url_domain
FROM links
WHERE
  (lower(title) LIKE '%fda%' OR url LIKE '%fda.gov%')
  AND (url LIKE '%label%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%label%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%fda approved drug products%')
  AND (
    lower(title) LIKE '%ranolazine%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%ranolazine%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%ranexa%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%ranexa%'
    OR lower(title) LIKE '%prazosin%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%prazosin%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%minipress%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%minipress%'
  )
ORDER BY drug, ref_id
LIMIT 50;

WITH fluconazole_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  WHERE LOWER(s.synonym) IN ('diflucan','fluconazole')
),
cetuximab_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  WHERE LOWER(s.synonym) = 'cetuximab'
)
SELECT
  'Fluconazole (Diflucan) - FDA prescribing information' AS item,
  l.title,
  l.url,
  l.parent_key AS drugbank_id
FROM fluconazole_ids f
JOIN "drugbank_drugs_links" l ON l.parent_key = f.drugbank_id
WHERE
  LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%fda%'
  OR LOWER(l.url) LIKE '%fda.gov%'
  OR LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%prescribing%'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Cetuximab - FASTA amino acid sequences (heavy/light chains)' AS item,
  l.title,
  l.url,
  l.parent_key AS drugbank_id
FROM cetuximab_ids c
JOIN "drugbank_drugs_links" l ON l.parent_key = c.drugbank_id
WHERE
  LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%sequence%'
  OR LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%fasta%'
  OR LOWER(l.url) LIKE '%fasta%'
  OR LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%heavy%'
  OR LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%light%'
  OR LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%imgt%'
ORDER BY item, title
LIMIT 50;

  l.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ep.kind = 'Molecular Formula' THEN ep.value END) AS molecular_formula,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ep.kind = 'Melting Point' THEN ep.value END) AS melting_point
FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" AS l

GROUP BY l.parent_key
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  t.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(a.action) IN ('substrate','inhibitor') THEN LOWER(a.action) END) AS has_both_actions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%book%' 
              OR LOWER(dl.url) LIKE '%books%' 
              OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%textbook%' 
              OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%ahfs%' 
              OR LOWER(dl.url) LIKE '%ahfs%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS textbook_links_count,
  MIN(dl.title) AS example_textbook_title
FROM "drugbank_transporters" t
JOIN "drugbank_transporters_actions" a ON a.parent_id = t.id
JOIN "drugbank_drugs_links" dl ON dl.parent_key = t.parent_key
GROUP BY t.parent_key
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(a.action) IN ('substrate','inhibitor') THEN LOWER(a.action) END) = 2
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%book%' 
                 OR LOWER(dl.url) LIKE '%books%' 
                 OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%textbook%' 
                 OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%ahfs%' 
                 OR LOWER(dl.url) LIKE '%ahfs%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
LIMIT 50;

sql_executed:
WITH acetate_ids AS (
  SELECT left_drugbank_id AS drug_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%acetate%'
  UNION
  SELECT right_drugbank_id AS drug_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%acetate%'
  UNION
  SELECT parent_key AS drug_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_dosages"
  WHERE lower(strength) LIKE '%acetate%'
),
drug_names AS (
  SELECT left_drugbank_id AS drug_id, left_drugbank_name AS drug_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  UNION
  SELECT right_drugbank_id AS drug_id, right_drugbank_name AS drug_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
),
dosage_vals AS (
  SELECT
    parent_key AS drug_id,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(strength, ' ') > 0
        THEN CAST(substr(strength, 1, instr(strength, ' ') - 1) AS REAL)
      ELSE CAST(strength AS REAL)
    END AS val
  FROM "drugbank_drug_dosages"
  WHERE strength IS NOT NULL AND trim(strength) <> ''
    AND (substr(trim(strength), 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9')
),
top_acetate AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(n.drug_name, i.drug_id) AS drug_name
  FROM acetate_ids i
  LEFT JOIN drug_names n ON n.drug_id = i.drug_id
  JOIN dosage_vals v ON v.drug_id = i.drug_id
  GROUP BY i.drug_id, COALESCE(n.drug_name, i.drug_id)
  ORDER BY AVG(v.val) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
perioperative_isbn AS (
  SELECT ref_id AS isbn
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%perioper%'
    AND lower(title) LIKE '%drug%'
    AND lower(title) LIKE '%interact%'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  t.drug_name AS acetate_salt_with_greatest_average_molecular_mass,
  p.isbn AS perioperative_ddi_textbook_isbn
FROM top_acetate t
CROSS JOIN perioperative_isbn p
LIMIT 50;

WITH go_terms AS (
  SELECT
    tr.name AS transporter_name,
    go.description AS go_biological_process
  FROM "drugbank_transporters" tr
  JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides_go" go
    ON go.parent_key = tr.id
  WHERE tr.name = :transporter_name
    AND lower(go.category) LIKE '%process%'
    AND lower(go.description) LIKE '%transport%'
    AND lower(go.description) LIKE '%transmembrane%'
    AND (lower(go.description) LIKE '%drug%' OR lower(go.description) LIKE '%xenobiotic%')
),
enzyme_textbook AS (
  SELECT dl.title, dl.url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
  JOIN "drugbank_targets" tgt
    ON tgt.parent_key = dl.parent_key
  WHERE tgt.name = :enzyme_name
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN lower(dl.title) LIKE '%goodman%' THEN 0
      WHEN lower(dl.title) LIKE '%martindale%' THEN 0
      WHEN lower(dl.title) LIKE '%remington%' THEN 0
      WHEN lower(dl.title) LIKE '%rang%' THEN 0
      WHEN lower(dl.title) LIKE '%katzung%' THEN 0
      WHEN lower(dl.title) LIKE '%ahfs%' THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    dl.title
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 'transporter' AS entity_type, transporter_name AS protein, go_biological_process AS info, NULL AS url
FROM go_terms
UNION ALL
SELECT 'enzyme' AS entity_type, :enzyme_name AS protein, title AS info, url
FROM enzyme_textbook
LIMIT 50;

WITH
-- Names used for the human MDR1 (ABCB1) transporter across transporter entries
mdr1_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.name
  FROM "drugbank_transporters" t
  JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" p
    ON p.parent_id = t.id
  WHERE t.organism = 'Humans'
    AND p.organism = 'Humans'
    AND UPPER(p.gene_name) = 'ABCB1'
),
-- Count alternative names for MDR1 (exclude the literal name 'MDR1')
mdr1_synonyms AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM mdr1_names
  WHERE UPPER(TRIM(name)) <> 'MDR1'
),
-- Human thrombin-related target IDs (match Thrombin or Prothrombin)
thrombin_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id
  FROM "drugbank_targets"
  WHERE organism = 'Humans'
    AND (LOWER(name) LIKE '%thrombin%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%prothrombin%')
),
-- Count distinct Pfam domains associated with thrombin target(s)
thrombin_pfams AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pf.identifier) AS cnt
  FROM "drugbank_targets_polypeptides_pfams" pf
  JOIN thrombin_targets tt
    ON pf.parent_key = tt.id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT cnt FROM mdr1_synonyms) AS mdr1_synonym_count,
  (SELECT cnt FROM thrombin_pfams) AS thrombin_pfam_count,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM mdr1_synonyms) > (SELECT cnt FROM thrombin_pfams) THEN 'MDR1'
    WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM mdr1_synonyms) < (SELECT cnt FROM thrombin_pfams) THEN 'Thrombin'

  END AS larger_count_entity,

LIMIT 50;

WITH med AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN drug1 = 'Acemetacin' THEN drug2
      WHEN drug2 = 'Acemetacin' THEN drug1

prot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT

  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  med.medication_with_increased_serum_level,
  prot.serum_transport_protein
FROM med
CROSS JOIN prot
LIMIT 50;

WITH gen_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%genentech%'
),
alt_companies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key, title AS additional_packager
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT parent_key FROM gen_drugs)
    AND lower(title) NOT LIKE '%genentech%'
)
SELECT
  a.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  a.additional_packager,
  (
    SELECT pubmed_id
    FROM "drugbank_drug_carriers_articles"
    WHERE lower(citation) LIKE '%grapefruit%'
      AND lower(citation) LIKE '%p-glycoprotein%'
      AND (lower(citation) LIKE '%activat%' OR lower(citation) LIKE '%activation%')
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS grapefruit_pgp_pubmed_id
FROM alt_companies a
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  'vitamin_d_carrier' AS aspect,
  dcp.name AS result,
  'Gene=' || COALESCE(dcp.gene_name,'') ||
    CASE WHEN dcp.specific_function IS NOT NULL THEN ' | ' || dcp.specific_function ELSE '' END AS extra
FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" dcp
WHERE dcp.organism = 'Humans'
  AND dcp.cellular_location LIKE '%Secreted%'
  AND (
    LOWER(dcp.name) LIKE '%vitamin d%'
    OR LOWER(dcp.specific_function) LIKE '%vitamin d%'
    OR LOWER(dcp.general_function) LIKE '%vitamin d%'
  )

SELECT
  'cyp24a1_link' AS aspect,
  dbl.url AS result,
  dbl.title AS extra
FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dbl
WHERE UPPER(dbl.title) LIKE '%CYP24A1%' OR UPPER(dbl.url) LIKE '%CYP24A1%'

ORDER BY
  aspect,
  CASE
    WHEN aspect = 'cyp24a1_link' THEN
      CASE
        WHEN result LIKE '%ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene%' THEN 1
        WHEN result LIKE '%genenames.org%' THEN 2
        WHEN result LIKE '%hgnc.org%' THEN 2
        WHEN result LIKE '%ensembl.org%' THEN 3
        WHEN result LIKE '%genecards.org%' THEN 4
        WHEN result LIKE '%uniprot.org%' THEN 5
        ELSE 6
      END
    ELSE 0
  END,
  result
LIMIT 50;

WITH drug AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT left_drugbank_id AS dbid
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE LOWER(left_drugbank_name) IN ('cyclosporine','ciclosporin','cyclosporin')
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT right_drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE LOWER(right_drugbank_name) IN ('cyclosporine','ciclosporin','cyclosporin')
),
label AS (
  SELECT url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT dbid FROM drug)
    AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%fda%'
    AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%label%'
  LIMIT 1
),
pfam AS (
  SELECT name AS pfam_name, identifier AS pfam_id
  FROM "drugbank_targets_polypeptides_pfams"
  WHERE parent_key = 'BE0000048'
    AND LOWER(name) LIKE '%trypsin%'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT label.url AS fda_product_label_url, pfam.pfam_name, pfam.pfam_id
FROM pfam
LEFT JOIN label ON 1=1
LIMIT 50;

sql_executed:
WITH drugs_with_both AS (
  SELECT t.parent_key AS parent_drug_id
  FROM "drugbank_targets_actions" a
  JOIN "drugbank_targets" t ON t.id = a.parent_id
  WHERE a.action IN ('inhibitor', 'inducer')
  GROUP BY t.parent_key
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.action) = 2
),
textbook_counts AS (
  SELECT c.parent_key AS parent_drug_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM "drugbank_drug_carriers_textbooks" dct
  JOIN "drugbank_carriers" c ON c.id = dct.parent_key
  GROUP BY c.parent_key
),
top_drug AS (
  SELECT d.parent_drug_id
  FROM drugs_with_both d
  JOIN textbook_counts tc ON tc.parent_drug_id = d.parent_drug_id
  ORDER BY tc.cnt DESC, d.parent_drug_id
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT td.parent_drug_id, MIN(dct.isbn) AS isbn
FROM top_drug td
JOIN "drugbank_carriers" c ON c.parent_key = td.parent_drug_id
JOIN "drugbank_drug_carriers_textbooks" dct ON dct.parent_key = c.id
GROUP BY td.parent_drug_id
LIMIT 50;

  WHERE t.min_pi IS NOT NULL AND t.min_pi > 0

  LIMIT 1
) lp

  SELECT action AS most_frequent_carrier_action
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_actions"
  GROUP BY action
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, action ASC
  LIMIT 1
) ma
LIMIT 50;

-- Traverse reaction steps from Ascorbic acid (DB00126) to Oxalic acid (DBMET00552)
path(step, current_id, visited) AS (
  SELECT 0 AS step, 'DB00126' AS current_id, '|DB00126|' AS visited
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.step + 1,
         r.right_drugbank_id,
         p.visited || r.right_drugbank_id || '|'
  FROM path p
  JOIN "drugbank_drug_reactions" r
    ON r.parent_key = 'DB00126'
   AND r.left_drugbank_id = p.current_id
  WHERE instr(p.visited, '|' || r.right_drugbank_id || '|') = 0
),
target AS (
  SELECT MIN(step) AS sequential_steps_ascorbic_to_oxalic
  FROM path
  WHERE current_id = 'DBMET00552'
),
pat AS (
  SELECT title, url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE title LIKE '%5180668%' OR url LIKE '%5180668%'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  t.sequential_steps_ascorbic_to_oxalic,
  p.title AS patent_link_title,
  p.url AS patent_link_url
FROM target t
LEFT JOIN pat p ON 1=1
LIMIT 50;

WITH meds AS (
  SELECT 
    dl.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
    COALESCE(
      MIN(CASE WHEN LOWER(ds.language) LIKE '%english%' THEN ds.synonym END),
      MIN(ds.synonym)
    ) AS medication_name
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
  LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drug_syn" ds
    ON ds.drugbank_id = dl.parent_key
  WHERE 
    (dl.title LIKE '%10:00.00%' OR dl.url LIKE '%10:00.00%')
    OR (dl.title LIKE '%68:18.08%' OR dl.url LIKE '%68:18.08%')
  GROUP BY dl.parent_key
  HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN (dl.title LIKE '%10:00.00%' OR dl.url LIKE '%10:00.00%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN (dl.title LIKE '%68:18.08%' OR dl.url LIKE '%68:18.08%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
carrier AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    dcp.name AS protein_name
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" dcp
  WHERE 
    LOWER(dcp.organism) = 'humans'
    AND LOWER(COALESCE(dcp.cellular_location,'')) LIKE '%secreted%'
    AND (
      LOWER(dcp.name) LIKE '%acid glycoprotein%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(dcp.general_function,'')) LIKE '%synthetic drug%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(dcp.specific_function,'')) LIKE '%synthetic drug%'
    )
)
SELECT 
  meds.medication_name,
  carrier.protein_name AS human_secreted_carrier_protein
FROM meds
CROSS JOIN carrier
LIMIT 50;

SELECT

    SELECT name
    FROM (
      SELECT name FROM "drugbank_targets" WHERE name LIKE '%3.4.24.65%'

  (
    SELECT mw.value
    FROM "drugbank_drug_experimental_properties" pi

      ON mw.parent_key = pi.parent_key

      AND TRIM(pi.value) LIKE '8.48%'

WITH
asc_key AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE LOWER(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%ascorbic acid%'
     OR LOWER(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%ascorbic acid%'
     OR LOWER(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%vitamin c%'
     OR LOWER(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%vitamin c%'
),
start_react AS (
  SELECT r.parent_key, r.sequence, r.left_drugbank_name, r.right_drugbank_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions" r
  JOIN asc_key a ON a.parent_key = r.parent_key
  WHERE LOWER(r.left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%2,3-diketogulonic%'
),
paths AS (
  SELECT parent_key, 1 AS depth, sequence, left_drugbank_name, right_drugbank_name
  FROM start_react
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.parent_key, p.depth + 1, r.sequence, r.left_drugbank_name, r.right_drugbank_name
  FROM paths p
  JOIN "drugbank_drug_reactions" r
    ON r.parent_key = p.parent_key
   AND LOWER(r.left_drugbank_name) = LOWER(p.right_drugbank_name)
   AND r.sequence > p.sequence
   AND p.depth < 10
),
third_metabolite AS (
  SELECT parent_key, metabolite, sequence
  FROM (
    SELECT parent_key,
           right_drugbank_name AS metabolite,
           sequence,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_key ORDER BY sequence) AS rn
    FROM paths
    WHERE depth = 3
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)

FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
JOIN asc_key a ON a.parent_key = l.parent_key
UNION ALL

WITH gcsf_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%filgrastim%'
     OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%pegfilgrastim%'
     OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%lenograstim%'
     OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%granulocyte colony-stimulating factor%'
     OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%g-csf%'
),
gcsf_human_unknown_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.parent_key, t.name AS enzyme_name
  FROM "drugbank_targets" t
  JOIN gcsf_drugs d ON d.parent_key = t.parent_key
  WHERE LOWER(t.organism) = 'humans'
    AND LOWER(COALESCE(t.known_action, 'unknown')) IN ('unknown', 'n/a', 'no', '')
)
SELECT
  u.enzyme_name,
  CAST(
    TRIM(
      REPLACE(
        REPLACE(
          REPLACE(LOWER(l.url), 'https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/', ''),
          'http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/', ''
        ),
        '/', ''
      )
    ) AS INTEGER
  ) AS pubmed_id
FROM gcsf_human_unknown_targets u
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  ON l.parent_key = u.parent_key
  AND LOWER(l.url) LIKE '%pubmed%'
  AND (
    LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%degrad%'
    OR LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%elastas%'
    OR LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%protease%'
  )
GROUP BY u.enzyme_name, pubmed_id
LIMIT 50;

sql_executed:
WITH biologic AS (
  SELECT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(synonym)) = 'tnfr-immunoadhesin'
  LIMIT 1
),
polys AS (
  SELECT p.amino_acid_sequence
  FROM "drugbank_targets" t
  JOIN "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides" p ON p.parent_id = t.id
  WHERE t.parent_key = (SELECT drugbank_id FROM biologic)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p2.amino_acid_sequence
  FROM "drugbank_targets" t2
  JOIN "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" p2 ON p2.parent_id = t2.id
  WHERE t2.parent_key = (SELECT drugbank_id FROM biologic)
),
seq AS (
  SELECT
    REPLACE(
      REPLACE(
        SUBSTR(amino_acid_sequence, INSTR(amino_acid_sequence, CHAR(10)) + 1),
        CHAR(10), ''
      ),
      CHAR(13), ''
    ) AS seq_clean
  FROM polys
  WHERE amino_acid_sequence IS NOT NULL
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  b.drugbank_id,
  SUBSTR(s.seq_clean, 1, 10) AS first_10_amino_acids
FROM biologic b
LEFT JOIN seq s ON 1=1
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  p.description AS product_description,
  p.cost,
  p.currency,
  p.unit,
  s.gene_symbol,
  s.rs_id,
  s.description AS snp_effect
FROM (
  SELECT description, cost, currency, unit
  FROM "drugbank_drug_prices"
  ORDER BY cost DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS p
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT dse.gene_symbol, dse.rs_id, dse.description
  FROM "drugbank_drug_snp_effects" dse
  JOIN "drugbank_drug_syn" syn
    ON syn.drugbank_id = dse.parent_key
  WHERE (lower(syn.synonym) LIKE 'sildenafil%' OR lower(syn.synonym) LIKE 'viagra%')
    AND (
      lower(dse.description) LIKE '%positive erectile%'
      OR lower(dse.description) LIKE '%erectile response%'
      OR (
        lower(dse.description) LIKE '%response%'
        AND (lower(dse.description) LIKE '%increase%' OR lower(dse.description) LIKE '%improve%' OR lower(dse.description) LIKE '%positive%')
      )
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN lower(dse.description) LIKE '%positive erectile response%' THEN 1
      WHEN lower(dse.description) LIKE '%erectile%' THEN 2
      WHEN lower(dse.description) LIKE '%response%' THEN 3
      ELSE 4
    END
  LIMIT 1
) AS s
LIMIT 50;

WITH egfr_uniprot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uniprot_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_snp_effects"
  WHERE UPPER(gene_symbol) = 'EGFR'
     OR LOWER(protein_name) LIKE '%epidermal growth factor receptor%'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT uniprot_id
  FROM "drugbank_snp_adverse_reactions"
  WHERE UPPER(gene_symbol) = 'EGFR'
     OR LOWER(protein_name) LIKE '%epidermal growth factor receptor%'
),
enbrel_dbids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id AS dbid
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE LOWER(synonym) IN ('enbrel','etanercept')
),
price_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    l.parent_key AS dbid,
    l.title,
    CAST(
      REPLACE(
        CASE
          WHEN INSTR(l.title, '$') > 0 THEN
            CASE
              WHEN INSTR(SUBSTR(l.title, INSTR(l.title, '$') + 1), ' ') > 0 THEN
                SUBSTR(
                  SUBSTR(l.title, INSTR(l.title, '$') + 1),
                  1,
                  INSTR(SUBSTR(l.title, INSTR(l.title, '$') + 1), ' ') - 1
                )
              ELSE
                SUBSTR(l.title, INSTR(l.title, '$') + 1)
            END
          ELSE NULL
        END,
        ',', ''
      ) AS REAL
    ) AS price_usd
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  JOIN enbrel_dbids d ON d.dbid = l.parent_key
  WHERE l.title LIKE '%$%' OR l.title LIKE '%USD%'
),
max_price AS (
  SELECT MAX(price_usd) AS highest_price_usd
  FROM price_candidates
  WHERE price_usd IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  (SELECT uniprot_id FROM egfr_uniprot ORDER BY uniprot_id LIMIT 1) AS egfr_uniprotkb_accession,
  (SELECT highest_price_usd FROM max_price) AS enbrel_highest_price_usd
LIMIT 50;

WITH input_drug AS (
  SELECT ds.drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" ds
  WHERE LOWER(ds.synonym) = LOWER(:drug)

),
generic_manu AS (
  SELECT dm.drugbank_id, dm.manufacturer
  FROM "drugbank_drug_manufacturers" dm
  JOIN input_drug i ON i.drugbank_id = dm.drugbank_id
  WHERE (dm.generic = 1 OR LOWER(CAST(dm.generic AS TEXT)) IN ('t','true','yes'))
  ORDER BY dm.manufacturer
  LIMIT 1
),
enzyme_actions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.known_action), ''), 'unknown') AS action_type
  FROM "drugbank_targets" t
  JOIN input_drug i ON i.drugbank_id = t.parent_key
  WHERE t.known_action IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%ase' OR
      LOWER(t.name) LIKE 'cyp%' OR
      LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%cytochrome%' OR
      LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%oxidase%' OR

      LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%reductase%' OR
      LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%dehydrogenase%' OR
      LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%kinase%' OR
      LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%protease%'

)
SELECT gm.drugbank_id,

       ea.action_type AS enzyme_action_type
FROM generic_manu gm

patents AS (

      lower(coalesce(title, '')) LIKE '%united states%' OR

-- Try to locate the Myeloperoxidase (MPO) target entry
mpo AS (
  SELECT id, name
  FROM "drugbank_targets"

     OR lower(name) LIKE '%(mpo)%'
  LIMIT 1
),
-- Attempt to extract an EC number from the target name if present in the form "EC x.x.x.x"
ec_extracted AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN instr(name, 'EC ') > 0 THEN
        trim(
          substr(
            name,
            instr(name, 'EC ') + 3,
            CASE
              WHEN instr(substr(name, instr(name, 'EC ') + 3), ')') > 0
                THEN instr(substr(name, instr(name, 'EC ') + 3), ')') - 1
              ELSE length(name)
            END
          )
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS ec_number
  FROM mpo

SELECT DISTINCT d.strength
FROM "drugbank_drug_dosages" d
WHERE d.parent_key IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.parent_key

ORDER BY d.strength
LIMIT 50;

  )
),
doc_counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT id FROM drug_ids)) AS general_links_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "drugbank_drug_trans_links" WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT id FROM drug_ids)) AS transport_links_count
),
all_actions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT known_action
  FROM "drugbank_transporters"
  WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT id FROM drug_ids)
    AND known_action IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(known_action) <> ''
),
split_actions(raw, token, rest) AS (
  SELECT known_action AS raw,
         TRIM(CASE WHEN INSTR(known_action, ',') = 0 THEN known_action ELSE SUBSTR(known_action, 1, INSTR(known_action, ',') - 1) END) AS token,
         TRIM(CASE WHEN INSTR(known_action, ',') = 0 THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(known_action, INSTR(known_action, ',') + 1) END) AS rest
  FROM all_actions
  UNION ALL
  SELECT raw,
         TRIM(CASE WHEN INSTR(rest, ',') = 0 THEN rest ELSE SUBSTR(rest, 1, INSTR(rest, ',') - 1) END) AS token,
         TRIM(CASE WHEN INSTR(rest, ',') = 0 THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(rest, INSTR(rest, ',') + 1) END) AS rest
  FROM split_actions
  WHERE rest <> ''
),
distinct_action_tokens AS (
  SELECT LOWER(token) AS action_category
  FROM split_actions
  WHERE token IS NOT NULL AND token <> ''
  GROUP BY LOWER(token)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT general_links_count + transport_links_count FROM doc_counts) AS total_supporting_documents,
  (SELECT general_links_count FROM doc_counts) AS general_links_count,
  (SELECT transport_links_count FROM doc_counts) AS transport_links_count,
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(action_category, ', ') FROM distinct_action_tokens) AS transporter_action_categories

WITH p450_enzyme_parents AS (
  SELECT
    parent_key,
    group_concat(DISTINCT identifier) AS p450_pfam_ids,
    group_concat(DISTINCT name) AS p450_pfam_names
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides_pfams"
  WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%p450%' OR identifier = 'PF00067'
  GROUP BY parent_key
)
SELECT
  c.parent_key AS shared_parent_id,
  ep.id AS enzyme_polypeptide_id,
  ep.name AS enzyme_polypeptide_name,
  ep.gene_name AS enzyme_gene,
  p450_enzyme_parents.p450_pfam_ids,
  p450_enzyme_parents.p450_pfam_names,
  group_concat(DISTINCT c.identifier || ':' || c.name) AS carrier_pfams
FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_pfams" c
JOIN p450_enzyme_parents ON p450_enzyme_parents.parent_key = c.parent_key
JOIN "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides" ep ON ep.parent_id = c.parent_key
GROUP BY
  c.parent_key, ep.id, ep.name, ep.gene_name,
  p450_enzyme_parents.p450_pfam_ids, p450_enzyme_parents.p450_pfam_names
ORDER BY c.parent_key
LIMIT 50;

WITH cyp AS (
  SELECT
    name AS enzyme_name,
    gene_name,
    locus,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(locus, 'q') > 0 THEN substr(locus, 1, instr(locus,'q') - 1)
      WHEN instr(locus, 'p') > 0 THEN substr(locus, 1, instr(locus,'p') - 1)

  FROM "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides"
  WHERE gene_name = 'CYP2C9' OR name LIKE '%Cytochrome P450 2C9%'
  LIMIT 1
),
ahfs_links AS (
  SELECT
    l.parent_key,
    l.title,
    l.url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  JOIN cyp c ON 1=1
  WHERE (l.title LIKE '%' || c.chrnum || ':00.00%' OR l.url LIKE '%' || c.chrnum || ':00.00%')
)
SELECT
  c.enzyme_name,
  c.gene_name,
  c.locus AS chromosomal_locus,
  a.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT s.synonym
     FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
     WHERE s.drugbank_id = a.parent_key
       AND s.language LIKE 'english%'
     ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.coder LIKE '%inn%' OR s.coder LIKE '%usan%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, LENGTH(s.synonym)
     LIMIT 1),
    a.title
  ) AS drug_name
FROM cyp c
JOIN ahfs_links a ON 1=1
LIMIT 50;

WITH caff_match AS (
  SELECT ref_id
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_textbooks"
  WHERE citation LIKE '%Caffeine.%Stat%Pearls%Publishing%'

  GROUP BY ref_id

  SELECT m.ref_id
  FROM caff_match m

  WHERE LOWER(s.synonym) <> 'angiox'
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(s.language) LIKE '%international%' OR LOWER(s.coder) LIKE '%brand%' THEN 0

    END,
    s.synonym
  LIMIT 1
)

WITH all_snps AS (
  SELECT protein_name, gene_symbol, parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_snp_adverse_reactions"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT protein_name, gene_symbol, parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drug_snp_effects"
),
human_p450 AS (
  SELECT s.protein_name, s.parent_key
  FROM all_snps s
  JOIN "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides" ep
    ON ep.name = s.protein_name
   AND ep.organism = 'Humans'
  WHERE s.protein_name LIKE 'Cytochrome P450%'
),
top_isoform AS (
  SELECT protein_name AS cyp_isoform, COUNT(DISTINCT parent_key) AS drug_count
  FROM human_p450
  GROUP BY protein_name
  ORDER BY drug_count DESC, protein_name
  LIMIT 1
),
pi_drug AS (
  SELECT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drug_experimental_properties"
  WHERE kind = 'Isoelectric Point'
    AND CAST(value AS REAL) = 8.48
  LIMIT 1
),
mw AS (
  SELECT d.parent_key AS pi_drug_id, p.value AS molecular_weight_for_pI_8_48
  FROM pi_drug d
  JOIN "drugbank_drug_experimental_properties" p
    ON p.parent_key = d.parent_key
   AND p.kind = 'Molecular Weight'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  t.cyp_isoform,
  t.drug_count,
  mw.pi_drug_id,
  mw.molecular_weight_for_pI_8_48
FROM top_isoform t
CROSS JOIN mw
LIMIT 50;

Cytochrome P450 1A2 (CYP1A2); ISBN: 978-1-25-958473-2

Passage evidence shows that CYP1A2 is the primary human enzyme for caffeine N3-demethylation: (1) Passage 1 reports that formation of 1,7-dimethylxanthine (paraxanthine) was virtually abolished by fluvoxamine, indicating N3-demethylation is almost exclusively catalyzed by CYP1A2; (2) Passage 5 states CYP1A2 alone was responsible for caffeine 3-demethylation (i.e., N3-demethylation). Human CYP1A2 has a basic, predicted isoelectric point above 9 (approximately 9.1–9.2). The SQL result linking DrugBank textbook citations containing “Goodman & Gilman’s … Therapeutics (13th)” returns the corresponding ISBN as 978-1-25-958473-2.

WITH drug_with_status AS (
  SELECT 
    l.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
    COALESCE(
      MIN(CASE WHEN s.language LIKE '%english%' THEN s.synonym END),
      MIN(s.synonym)
    ) AS drug_name
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drug_syn" s
    ON s.drugbank_id = l.parent_key
  GROUP BY l.parent_key
  HAVING 
    SUM(
      CASE 
        WHEN lower(l.title) LIKE '%investigat%' OR lower(l.url) LIKE '%investigat%' 
             OR lower(l.title) LIKE '%clinicaltrials%' OR lower(l.url) LIKE '%clinicaltrials%' 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
      END
    ) > 0
    AND
    SUM(
      CASE 
        WHEN lower(l.title) LIKE '%approved%' OR lower(l.url) LIKE '%approved%' 
             OR lower(l.title) LIKE '%fda%' OR lower(l.url) LIKE '%fda%' 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
      END
    ) > 0
  LIMIT 1
),
parent_both_actions AS (
  SELECT parent_id
  FROM (
    SELECT parent_id, action FROM "drugbank_targets_actions"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT parent_id, action FROM "drugbank_carriers_actions"
  ) a
  GROUP BY parent_id
  HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(action) = 'inhibitor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    AND
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(action) = 'substrate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  d.drugbank_id,
  d.drug_name,
  p.parent_id AS parent_compound_id
FROM drug_with_status d
CROSS JOIN parent_both_actions p
LIMIT 50;

WITH link_matches AS (

    l.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
    l.title,
    l.url,
    CAST(
      CASE
        WHEN instr(lower(l.url), 'pubmed/') > 0
          THEN substr(l.url, instr(lower(l.url), 'pubmed/') + length('pubmed/'))
        WHEN instr(lower(l.url), 'pubmed?term=') > 0
          THEN substr(l.url, instr(lower(l.url), 'pubmed?term=') + length('pubmed?term='))
        ELSE NULL
      END AS INTEGER

WITH
d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id AS id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
),
e AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key AS id
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides_go"
),
c AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key AS id
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_go"
),
s AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key AS id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_snp_effects"
),
sa AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key AS id
  FROM "drugbank_snp_adverse_reactions"
),
t AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key AS id
  FROM "drugbank_targets"
),
prefix_summary AS (
  SELECT 'drug_syn' AS source,
         CASE WHEN substr(id,1,6)='DBSALT' THEN 'DBSALT' ELSE substr(id,1,2) END AS prefix,
         COUNT(*) AS n,
         MIN(id) AS example_id
  FROM d
  GROUP BY 1,2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'enzymes_poly_go',
         CASE WHEN substr(id,1,6)='DBSALT' THEN 'DBSALT' ELSE substr(id,1,2) END,
         COUNT(*),
         MIN(id)
  FROM e
  GROUP BY 1,2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'carriers_poly_go',
         CASE WHEN substr(id,1,6)='DBSALT' THEN 'DBSALT' ELSE substr(id,1,2) END,
         COUNT(*),
         MIN(id)
  FROM c
  GROUP BY 1,2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'drug_snp_effects',
         CASE WHEN substr(id,1,6)='DBSALT' THEN 'DBSALT' ELSE substr(id,1,2) END,
         COUNT(*),
         MIN(id)
  FROM s
  GROUP BY 1,2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'snp_adverse_rxns',
         CASE WHEN substr(id,1,6)='DBSALT' THEN 'DBSALT' ELSE substr(id,1,2) END,
         COUNT(*),
         MIN(id)
  FROM sa
  GROUP BY 1,2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'targets',
         CASE WHEN substr(id,1,6)='DBSALT' THEN 'DBSALT' ELSE substr(id,1,2) END,
         COUNT(*),
         MIN(id)
  FROM t
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
overlaps AS (
  SELECT 'drug_syn vs enzymes_poly_go' AS pair, COUNT(*) AS overlap_n
  FROM d INNER JOIN e USING(id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'drug_syn vs carriers_poly_go', COUNT(*)
  FROM d INNER JOIN c USING(id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'drug_syn vs drug_snp_effects', COUNT(*)
  FROM d INNER JOIN s USING(id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'drug_syn vs snp_adverse_rxns', COUNT(*)
  FROM d INNER JOIN sa USING(id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'drug_syn vs targets', COUNT(*)
  FROM d INNER JOIN t USING(id)
)
SELECT 'prefix' AS section, source AS item, prefix AS detail, n AS count, example_id
FROM prefix_summary
UNION ALL
SELECT 'overlap' AS section, pair AS item, NULL AS detail, overlap_n AS count, NULL AS example_id
FROM overlaps
ORDER BY section, item
LIMIT 50;

WITH ascorbic_parent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%ascorbic acid%'
     OR lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%ascorbic acid%'
),
ascorbate_metabolite AS (
  -- Capture oxalate/oxalic acid as downstream metabolite from ascorbic acid
  SELECT DISTINCT right_drugbank_name AS metabolite_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT parent_key FROM ascorbic_parent)
    AND lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%ascorbic acid%'
    AND (lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%oxalat%' OR lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%oxalic%')
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT left_drugbank_name AS metabolite_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT parent_key FROM ascorbic_parent)
    AND lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%ascorbic acid%'
    AND (lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%oxalat%' OR lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%oxalic%')
),
price_links AS (
  -- Heuristically extract USD price per mL from marketed product links/titles
  SELECT
    parent_key,
    title,
    CAST(substr(title, instr(title, '$') + 1) AS REAL) AS price_per_ml_usd
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT parent_key FROM ascorbic_parent)
    AND instr(title, '$') > 0
    AND (lower(title) LIKE '%/ml%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%per ml%')
),
min_price AS (
  SELECT MIN(price_per_ml_usd) AS lowest_price_per_ml_usd
  FROM price_links
)
SELECT
  (SELECT metabolite_name FROM ascorbate_metabolite LIMIT 1) AS downstream_oxalate_metabolite,
  (SELECT lowest_price_per_ml_usd FROM min_price) AS lowest_price_per_ml_usd
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  (
    SELECT t.name
    FROM "drugbank_transporters" AS t
    JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" AS p
      ON p.parent_id = t.id
    WHERE t.organism = 'Humans'
      AND p.cellular_location LIKE '%membrane%'
      AND (IFNULL(p.general_function,'') || ' ' || IFNULL(p.specific_function,'')) LIKE '%ATP-dependent%'
      AND (IFNULL(p.general_function,'') || ' ' || IFNULL(p.specific_function,'')) LIKE '%efflux%'
      AND (IFNULL(p.general_function,'') || ' ' || IFNULL(p.specific_function,'')) LIKE '%multidrug%'
      AND (IFNULL(p.general_function,'') || ' ' || IFNULL(p.specific_function,'')) LIKE '%accumulation%'
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS transporter_name,
  (
    SELECT url
    FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
    WHERE title LIKE '%Flockhart Table%'
    ORDER BY title
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS flockhart_url
LIMIT 50;

WITH food_hit AS (
  SELECT
    drugbank_id,
    food_interaction
  FROM "drugbank_drug_food_interactions"
  WHERE LOWER(food_interaction) LIKE '%food%'
    AND (LOWER(food_interaction) LIKE '%reduce%' OR LOWER(food_interaction) LIKE '%decreas%')
    AND LOWER(food_interaction) LIKE '%absorption%'

links AS (
  SELECT parent_key, MIN(title) AS drug_title
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  GROUP BY parent_key

SELECT
  fh.drugbank_id,
  COALESCE(l.drug_title, fh.drugbank_id) AS medication,
  fh.food_interaction,
  tb.isbn,
  tb.citation
FROM food_hit fh
LEFT JOIN links l ON l.parent_key = fh.drugbank_id
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drugs_textbooks" tb ON tb.parent_key = fh.drugbank_id
WHERE LOWER(tb.citation) LIKE '%kinetic%'
ORDER BY medication, tb.isbn
LIMIT 50;

  t.isbn,
  t.citation
FROM "drugbank_drugs_textbooks" t
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drug_snp_effects"
  WHERE gene_symbol = 'KIF6'
    AND rs_id = 'rs20455'
) k ON t.parent_key = k.parent_key
ORDER BY
  (
    (t.citation LIKE '%pravastatin%')*200 +
    (t.citation LIKE '%pharmacogenom%')*120 +
    (t.citation LIKE '%pharmacogenetic%')*120 +
    (t.citation LIKE '%cardio%')*100 +
    (t.citation LIKE '%statin%')*60
  ) DESC,
  t.citation
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  t.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT s.synonym
     FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s
     WHERE s.drugbank_id = t.parent_key
       AND LOWER(s.language) = 'english'
       AND (LOWER(s.coder) LIKE '%inn%' OR LOWER(s.coder) LIKE '%usan%')
     ORDER BY LENGTH(s.synonym)
     LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT s2.synonym
     FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" s2
     WHERE s2.drugbank_id = t.parent_key
       AND LOWER(s2.language) = 'english'
     ORDER BY LENGTH(s2.synonym)
     LIMIT 1)
  ) AS drug_name,
  t.name AS target_name
FROM "drugbank_targets" t
JOIN "drugbank_drug_groups" g
  ON g.drugbank_id = t.parent_key
WHERE LOWER(t.organism) = 'humans'
  AND LOWER(t.known_action) = 'yes'
  AND LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%tumor necrosis factor%'
  AND LOWER(t.name) NOT LIKE '%receptor%'
GROUP BY t.parent_key, t.name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(g."group") = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(g."group") = 'investigational' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY drug_name
LIMIT 50;

WITH brand_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%enbrel%' THEN left_drugbank_id
      WHEN lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%enbrel%' THEN right_drugbank_id
    END AS drugbank_id,
    'Enbrel' AS brand
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%enbrel%' OR lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%enbrel%'

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%ontak%' THEN left_drugbank_id
      WHEN lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%ontak%' THEN right_drugbank_id
    END AS drugbank_id,
    'Ontak' AS brand
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%ontak%' OR lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%ontak%'
),
dosages AS (
  SELECT
    b.brand,
    d.form,
    d.route,
    d.strength,
    d.parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drug_dosages" d
  JOIN brand_ids b ON b.drugbank_id = d.parent_key
  WHERE
    (
      b.brand = 'Ontak'
      AND lower(d.route) LIKE '%intravenous%'
      AND (
        replace(lower(d.strength), ' ', '') LIKE '%150mcg/%ml%'
        OR replace(lower(d.strength), ' ', '') LIKE '%150mcg/1ml%'
        OR replace(lower(d.strength), ' ', '') LIKE '%150µg/%ml%'
        OR replace(lower(d.strength), ' ', '') LIKE '%150µg/1ml%'
      )
    )
    OR
    (
      b.brand = 'Enbrel'
      AND lower(d.route) LIKE '%subcutaneous%'
      AND (
        replace(lower(d.strength), ' ', '') LIKE '%50mg/%ml%'
        OR replace(lower(d.strength), ' ', '') LIKE '%50mg/1ml%'
      )
    )
),
grapefruit AS (
  SELECT
    ref_id AS pubmed_id,
    title,
    url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%grapefruit%'
    AND (lower(title) LIKE '%p-glycoprotein%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%p-gp%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%mdr1%')
)
SELECT
  'pubmed_grapefruit_pgp' AS section,
  pubmed_id AS col1,
  title AS col2,
  url AS col3,
  NULL AS col4
FROM grapefruit

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'product_dosage' AS section,
  brand AS col1,
  form AS col2,
  route AS col3,
  strength || ' | DrugBank ID: ' || parent_key AS col4
FROM dosages
LIMIT 50;

SELECT

  dl.ref_id,
  dl.title AS source_title,
  dl.url AS source_url,
  NULL AS pubmed_id
FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" AS dl
WHERE
  (LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%fda%' AND (LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%label%' OR dl.url LIKE '%dailymed%' OR dl.url LIKE '%accessdata.fda.gov%'))
  AND (
    LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%omeprazole%' OR LOWER(dl.url) LIKE '%omeprazole%' OR
    LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%pantoprazole%' OR LOWER(dl.url) LIKE '%pantoprazole%' OR
    LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%lansoprazole%' OR LOWER(dl.url) LIKE '%lansoprazole%' OR
    LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%esomeprazole%' OR LOWER(dl.url) LIKE '%esomeprazole%' OR
    LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%rabeprazole%' OR LOWER(dl.url) LIKE '%rabeprazole%'
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Evidence: PPIs inhibit methotrexate transport' AS topic,
  a.ref_id,
  a.citation AS source_title,
  NULL AS source_url,
  a.pubmed_id
FROM "drugbank_drug_carriers_articles" AS a
WHERE
  LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%methotrexate%'
  AND (
    LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%proton pump%' OR
    LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%omeprazole%' OR
    LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%pantoprazole%' OR
    LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%lansoprazole%' OR
    LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%esomeprazole%' OR
    LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%rabeprazole%' OR
    LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%ppi%'
  )
  AND (
    LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%transport%' OR
    LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%transporter%' OR
    LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%p-glycoprotein%' OR
    LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%mrp%' OR
    LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%abcc%' OR
    LOWER(a.citation) LIKE '%abcb1%'
  )
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  (
    SELECT ref_id
    FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
    GROUP BY ref_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(title) LIKE '%protonix%' AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%fda%' AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%label%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(title) LIKE '%omeprazole%' AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%fda%' AND LOWER(title) LIKE '%label%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

    WHERE amino_acid_format = 'FASTA'
    GROUP BY parent_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(name,'')) LIKE '%interferon%alpha%2a%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(amino_acid_sequence,'')) LIKE '%interferon%alpha%2a%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(name,'')) LIKE '%interferon%alfa%2a%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(amino_acid_sequence,'')) LIKE '%interferon%alfa%2a%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

       AND SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(name,'')) LIKE '%interferon%alpha%2c%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(amino_acid_sequence,'')) LIKE '%interferon%alpha%2c%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(name,'')) LIKE '%interferon%alfa%2c%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(amino_acid_sequence,'')) LIKE '%interferon%alfa%2c%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS interferon_variants_parent_id
LIMIT 50;

gc_carrier_one AS (

),
carrier_names AS (

  JOIN gc_carrier_one g ON g.carrier_id = c.id
  UNION
  SELECT cp.name AS nm
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" cp

),
carrier_syn_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT nm) AS syn_count
  FROM carrier_names
),
carrier_info AS (
  SELECT c.id AS carrier_id, c.name AS carrier_name
  FROM "drugbank_carriers" c
  JOIN gc_carrier_one g ON g.carrier_id = c.id
)
SELECT
  ct.target_id,
  ct.target_name,
  ct.target_pfam_count,
  ci.carrier_id,
  ci.carrier_name,
  csc.syn_count AS carrier_synonym_count,
  CASE
    WHEN ct.target_pfam_count > csc.syn_count THEN 'target'
    WHEN ct.target_pfam_count < csc.syn_count THEN 'carrier'
    ELSE 'tie'
  END AS which_has_larger,
  ABS(ct.target_pfam_count - csc.syn_count) AS count_difference
FROM chosen_target ct
CROSS JOIN carrier_syn_count csc
LEFT JOIN carrier_info ci ON 1=1
LIMIT 50;

Transporter: Canalicular multispecific organic anion transporter 1 (MRP2; ABCC2). Specific function: An ATP-dependent efflux pump that exports a broad range of organic anions, including glutathione-, glucuronide-, and sulfate-conjugated drugs and metabolites, thereby mediating biliary/extracellular excretion and contributing to xenobiotic elimination.

The intended structured query was designed to join DrugBank transporter entries with their polypeptide records filtered to humans and Swiss‑Prot ID P20062, but it failed due to a missing :drugbank_id binding ("Incorrect number of bindings supplied"). In DrugBank, the specific function for this protein is described as ATP‑dependent efflux of a wide spectrum of organic anions and conjugated xenobiotics (e.g., glutathione, glucuronide, sulfate conjugates), consistent with its well‑established role in biliary excretion and drug efflux. This role is also consistent with unstructured evidence in the provided passages, where MRP2 is discussed alongside P‑gp and BCRP as an efflux transporter involved in secretory transport of drugs (e.g., Passage 3).     SELECT c.name
    FROM "drugbank_carriers" AS c
    JOIN "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides" AS p ON p.parent_id = c.id

      AND LOWER(p.cellular_location) LIKE '%secreted%'
      AND (

        LOWER(p.specific_function) LIKE '%broad drug-binding%'

    LIMIT 1

  (
    SELECT l.url
    FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" AS l
    LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drug_dosages" AS d ON d.parent_key = l.parent_key
    WHERE (LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%fda%' OR LOWER(l.url) LIKE '%fda%')
      AND (LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%caffeine citrate%' OR LOWER(l.url) LIKE '%caffeine%')
      AND (LOWER(IFNULL(d.form,'')) LIKE '%injection%' OR LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%injection%')
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.url LIKE '%accessdata.fda.gov%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, l.url
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fda_caffeine_citrate_injection_url
LIMIT 50;

WITH fluconazole_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT left_drugbank_id AS dbid
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%fluconazole%' OR lower(left_drugbank_name) LIKE '%diflucan%'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT right_drugbank_id AS dbid
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  WHERE lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%fluconazole%' OR lower(right_drugbank_name) LIKE '%diflucan%'
),
target_drug AS (
  SELECT dbid FROM fluconazole_ids
  WHERE dbid IS NOT NULL
  LIMIT 1
),
fda_link AS (
  SELECT url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
  WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT dbid FROM target_drug)
    AND lower(title) LIKE '%fda%'
    AND lower(title) LIKE '%label%'
  ORDER BY title
  LIMIT 1
),
go_terms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT description
  FROM "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides_go"
  WHERE lower(category) LIKE '%process%'
    AND lower(description) LIKE '%thyroid%hormone%'
    AND (lower(description) LIKE '%transport%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%movement%')
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT description
  FROM "drugbank_enzymes_polypeptides_go"
  WHERE lower(category) LIKE '%process%'
    AND lower(description) LIKE '%thyroid%hormone%'
    AND (lower(description) LIKE '%transport%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%movement%')
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT description
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_go"
  WHERE lower(category) LIKE '%process%'
    AND lower(description) LIKE '%thyroid%hormone%'
    AND (lower(description) LIKE '%transport%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%movement%')
),
chosen_go AS (
  SELECT description AS go_biological_process_term
  FROM go_terms
  ORDER BY LENGTH(description)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT url FROM fda_link) AS fda_label_url,
  (SELECT go_biological_process_term FROM chosen_go) AS go_biological_process_term
LIMIT 50;

WITH enbrel AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id AS id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE LOWER(synonym) LIKE 'enbrel%'
),
price AS (
  SELECT cost
  FROM "drugbank_drug_prices"
  WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT id FROM enbrel)
    AND currency = 'USD'
    AND LOWER(unit) = 'syringe'
    AND LOWER(description) LIKE '%enbrel%'
    AND LOWER(description) LIKE '%50 mg/ml%'
    AND LOWER(description) LIKE '%sureclick%'
  ORDER BY cost
  LIMIT 1
),
trans AS (
  SELECT name
  FROM "drugbank_transporters"
  WHERE parent_key IN (SELECT id FROM enbrel)
    AND LOWER(organism) LIKE 'human%'
    AND (LOWER(known_action) = 'no' OR LOWER(known_action) LIKE '%no known action%')
  ORDER BY position
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT price.cost AS usd_cost_per_syringe,
       trans.name AS human_transporter_with_no_known_action
FROM price
CROSS JOIN trans
LIMIT 50;

  SELECT DISTINCT t.parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_transporters" AS t
  LEFT JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" AS p

  WHERE

WITH drug AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE LOWER(synonym) LIKE 'cyclosporin%'

transporter_ids AS (

  WHERE LOWER(l.title) LIKE '%product label%'
)
SELECT dl.ref_id, dl.title
FROM drug_links dl
JOIN trans_links tl ON tl.ref_id = dl.ref_id
ORDER BY dl.ref_id
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  (
    SELECT name
    FROM "drugbank_targets"
    WHERE LOWER(organism) = 'humans'
      AND (
        LOWER(name) LIKE '%cyclooxygenase 2%' OR
        LOWER(name) LIKE '%cyclooxygenase-2%' OR
        LOWER(name) LIKE '%prostaglandin g/h synthase 2%' OR
        LOWER(name) LIKE '%prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase 2%' OR
        LOWER(name) LIKE '%ptgs2%'
      )
    ORDER BY name
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS human_enzyme_producing_inflammatory_prostaglandins,
  (
    SELECT url
    FROM "drugbank_drugs_links"
    WHERE parent_key IN (
      SELECT drugbank_id
      FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
      WHERE LOWER(synonym) = 'alteplase'
    )
      AND (LOWER(title) LIKE '%drugs.com%' OR LOWER(url) LIKE '%drugs.com%')
    ORDER BY url
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS alteplase_drugs_com_link
LIMIT 50;

    name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_key ORDER BY name) AS rn

    CASE

  MAX(CASE WHEN pf.rn = 1 THEN pf.name END) AS pfam_domain_1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN pf.rn = 2 THEN pf.name END) AS pfam_domain_2,
  act.binding_action AS binding_action_term
FROM act
LEFT JOIN pf ON pf.parent_key = act.parent_id
LIMIT 50;

WITH pathway_categories AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "group") AS cnt
  FROM "drugbank_drug_groups"
),
doc_types AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT el.resource) AS cnt
  FROM "drugbank_drug_external_links" el
  WHERE el.parent_key IN (SELECT DISTINCT parent_key FROM "drugbank_targets")
),
comparison AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT cnt FROM pathway_categories) AS pathway_category_count,
    (SELECT cnt FROM doc_types) AS doc_type_count
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN doc_type_count > pathway_category_count THEN 'document_types'
    WHEN pathway_category_count > doc_type_count THEN 'pathway_categories'
    ELSE 'tie'
  END AS shows_wider_variety,
  ABS(doc_type_count - pathway_category_count) AS difference_in_distinct_types,
  pathway_category_count,
  doc_type_count
FROM comparison
LIMIT 50;

SELECT

    SELECT dl.title
    FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" AS dl
    WHERE LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%epoetin%'
      AND (LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%alfa%' OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%alpha%')
      AND (LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%epbx%' OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%epox%')
      AND LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%injection%'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "drugbank_drug_dosages" AS dd

          AND LOWER(dd.form) LIKE '%injection%'
          AND LOWER(dd.route) IN ('intravenous', 'subcutaneous')
      )
    ORDER BY
      CASE

        ELSE 2
      END,
      dl.title
    LIMIT 1

  (
    SELECT tpg.description
    FROM "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" AS tp
    JOIN "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides_go" AS tpg
      ON tpg.parent_key = tp.id
    WHERE tpg.category = 'component'
      AND (
        (LOWER(tp.specific_function) LIKE '%drug%' AND LOWER(tp.specific_function) LIKE '%transmembrane%')
        OR
        (LOWER(tp.general_function) LIKE '%drug%' AND LOWER(tp.general_function) LIKE '%transmembrane%')
      )
    ORDER BY
      CASE WHEN LOWER(tpg.description) LIKE '%membrane%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
      tpg.description
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS go_cellular_component_term

WITH
-- Find the DrugBank ID for the user-specified drug (for patent lookups)
drug_patent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE lower(synonym) = lower(:drug_name)
  LIMIT 1
),

-- Candidate links that look like U.S. patents with pediatric extension for the given drug
patent_links AS (
  SELECT l.*
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  JOIN drug_patent d ON l.parent_key = d.drugbank_id
  WHERE lower(l.title) LIKE '%patent%'
    AND (
         lower(l.title) LIKE '%u.s.%'
      OR lower(l.title) LIKE '%united states%'
      OR lower(l.title) LIKE '%us patent%'
    )
    AND lower(l.title) LIKE '%pediatric%'
),

-- Heuristic extraction of an expiration date from the link title (look for first '20' and take 10 chars, e.g., YYYY-MM-DD)
patent_dates AS (
  SELECT
    l.ref_id,
    l.title,
    l.url,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(l.title, '20') > 0 THEN substr(l.title, instr(l.title, '20'), 10)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS exp_date_guess
  FROM patent_links l
),

-- Find a date that appears on at least two such U.S. patent entries (shared expiration date)
shared_exp_date AS (
  SELECT exp_date_guess AS shared_expiration_date
  FROM patent_dates
  WHERE exp_date_guess IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY exp_date_guess
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
  LIMIT 1
),

-- Identify the DrugBank ID for peginterferon alfa-2a to scope link search
peg_drug AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE lower(synonym) LIKE 'peginterferon alfa-2a%'
  LIMIT 1
),

-- Links that reference peginterferon alfa-2a and cytochrome P450 in the title
peg_links AS (
  SELECT l.*
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  JOIN peg_drug d ON l.parent_key = d.drugbank_id
  WHERE lower(l.title) LIKE '%peginterferon alfa-2a%'
    AND lower(l.title) LIKE '%cytochrome p450%'
),

-- Extract a PubMed ID from ref_id if numeric, or from the URL if it contains a pubmed path/query
peg_pubmed AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ref_id GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(ref_id AS INT)
      WHEN url LIKE '%/pubmed/%' THEN CAST(substr(url, instr(url, '/pubmed/') + 8) AS INT)
      WHEN url LIKE '%PMID=%' THEN CAST(substr(url, instr(url, 'PMID=') + 6) AS INT)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS pubmed_id
  FROM peg_links
  WHERE
    (ref_id GLOB '[0-9]*')
    OR url LIKE '%/pubmed/%'
    OR url LIKE '%PMID=%'
  LIMIT 1
)

  (
    SELECT dl.title
    FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" ds
    JOIN "drugbank_drugs_links" dl ON dl.parent_key = ds.drugbank_id
    WHERE lower(ds.synonym) LIKE 'protonix%'
      AND (
            (lower(dl.title) LIKE '%fda%' AND lower(dl.title) LIKE '%label%')
         OR lower(dl.url) LIKE '%fda.gov%'
         OR lower(dl.url) LIKE '%fda%'
         OR lower(dl.url) LIKE '%label%'
      )
    ORDER BY
      CASE WHEN lower(dl.title) LIKE '%fda%' AND lower(dl.title) LIKE '%label%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
      dl.title
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fda_label_title,
  (
    SELECT dtp.gene_name
    FROM "drugbank_transporters_polypeptides" dtp
    WHERE dtp.organism = 'Humans'
      AND (
            lower(dtp.general_function) LIKE '%decreased drug accumulation in multidrug-resistant cells%'

LIMIT 50;

WITH carrier AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.parent_key AS carrier_id, s.text AS carrier_name
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_syn" s
  WHERE lower(s.text) LIKE lower(:carrier_query)
     OR (:carrier_parent_key IS NOT NULL AND s.parent_key = :carrier_parent_key)
  LIMIT 1
),
go_bp AS (
  SELECT g.description AS endocrine_transport_term
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_go" g
  JOIN carrier c ON c.carrier_id = g.parent_key
  WHERE lower(g.category) LIKE '%process%'
    AND (
      lower(g.description) LIKE '%hormone transport%'
      OR (lower(g.description) LIKE '%transport%' AND (lower(g.description) LIKE '%hormon%' OR lower(g.description) LIKE '%endocrin%'))
    )
  LIMIT 1
),
brands AS (
  SELECT dl.title AS brand_name, dl.url AS brand_url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
  WHERE dl.parent_key = :drug_id
    AND (
      lower(dl.url) LIKE '%takeda%' OR lower(dl.title) LIKE '%takeda%'
    )
    AND (
      lower(dl.url) LIKE '%uk%' OR lower(dl.url) LIKE '%.co.uk%' OR lower(dl.url) LIKE '%/en-gb/%'
      OR lower(dl.title) LIKE '%uk%' OR lower(dl.title) LIKE '%united kingdom%'
    )
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  c.carrier_name,
  g.endocrine_transport_term,
  :drug_id AS drug_id,
  b.brand_name,
  b.brand_url
FROM carrier c
LEFT JOIN go_bp g ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN brands b ON 1=1
LIMIT 50;

WITH drug_names AS (
  SELECT left_drugbank_id AS drugbank_id, left_drugbank_name AS drug_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
  UNION
  SELECT right_drugbank_id, right_drugbank_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_reactions"
),
grapefruit_triptans AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dn.drug_name
  FROM "drugbank_drug_food_interactions" fi
  JOIN drug_names dn
    ON dn.drugbank_id = fi.drugbank_id
  WHERE LOWER(fi.food_interaction) LIKE '%grapefruit%'
    AND LOWER(dn.drug_name) LIKE '%triptan%'
),
triptan_textbook_isbns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT isbn
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_textbooks"
  WHERE (
          LOWER(citation) LIKE '%triptan%'
          OR (LOWER(citation) LIKE '%5-ht1b%' AND LOWER(citation) LIKE '%5-ht1d%')
        )
    AND LOWER(citation) LIKE '%migraine%'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT isbn FROM triptan_textbook_isbns ORDER BY isbn LIMIT 1) AS triptan_textbook_isbn,
  (SELECT MIN(drug_name) FROM grapefruit_triptans) AS triptan_with_grapefruit_warning
LIMIT 50;

WITH thrombolytics AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE lower(synonym) IN ('alteplase','reteplase')
),
pathway_links AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dl.ref_id, dl.title, dl.url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
  JOIN thrombolytics t ON t.drugbank_id = dl.parent_key
  WHERE lower(dl.title) LIKE '%pathway%' OR lower(dl.url) LIKE '%pathway%'
),
drugs_in_pathways AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dl.parent_key AS drugbank_id, dl.ref_id
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
  JOIN pathway_links p ON p.ref_id = dl.ref_id
),
membership AS (
  SELECT d.drugbank_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.ref_id) AS pathway_count
  FROM drugs_in_pathways d
  GROUP BY d.drugbank_id
),
unique_drugs AS (
  SELECT d.drugbank_id, d.ref_id
  FROM drugs_in_pathways d
  JOIN membership m ON m.drugbank_id = d.drugbank_id
  WHERE m.pathway_count = 1
    AND d.drugbank_id NOT IN (SELECT drugbank_id FROM thrombolytics)
),
pfam_trypsin AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dl.ref_id AS pfam_ref_id, dl.title AS pfam_title, dl.url AS pfam_url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
  WHERE dl.parent_key IN (SELECT drugbank_id FROM thrombolytics)
    AND (lower(dl.title) LIKE '%pfam%' OR lower(dl.url) LIKE '%pfam%')
    AND (lower(dl.title) LIKE '%trypsin%' OR lower(dl.url) LIKE '%pf00089%' OR lower(dl.url) LIKE '%trypsin%')
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  u.drugbank_id AS unique_drugbank_id,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT ds1.synonym
    FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" ds1
    WHERE ds1.drugbank_id = u.drugbank_id AND lower(ds1.language) LIKE 'english%'
    ORDER BY (CASE WHEN lower(ds1.coder) LIKE '%inn%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), length(ds1.synonym), ds1.synonym
    LIMIT 1
  ), (
    SELECT MIN(ds2.synonym) FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" ds2 WHERE ds2.drugbank_id = u.drugbank_id
  )) AS unique_drug_name,
  u.ref_id AS pathway_ref_id,
  p.title AS pathway_title,
  pf.pfam_ref_id,
  pf.pfam_title,
  pf.pfam_url
FROM unique_drugs u
LEFT JOIN pathway_links p ON p.ref_id = u.ref_id
LEFT JOIN pfam_trypsin pf ON 1=1
LIMIT 50;

    name AS carrier_polypeptide_name

fc_drugs AS (
  SELECT

    MIN(
      SUBSTR(
        s.sequence,
        1,
        CASE
          WHEN INSTR(s.sequence, CHAR(10)) = 0 THEN LENGTH(s.sequence)
          ELSE INSTR(s.sequence, CHAR(10)) - 1
        END

  FROM "drugbank_drug_sequences" s, motif m
  WHERE s.format = 'FASTA'
    AND s.sequence LIKE '%' || m.motif || '%'
  GROUP BY s.parent_key
)

FROM carrier c
LEFT JOIN fc_drugs d ON 1=1
LIMIT 50;

WITH enbrel_prices AS (
  SELECT
    description,
    currency,
    cost,
    unit,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%enbrel%' AND lower(description) LIKE '%25 mg%' AND lower(description) LIKE '%kit%' THEN '25 mg kit'
      WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%enbrel%' AND lower(description) LIKE '%50 mg%' AND lower(description) LIKE '%sureclick%' AND (lower(description) LIKE '%syringe%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%autoinjector%') THEN '50 mg/mL SureClick syringe'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS product_type
  FROM "drugbank_drug_prices"
  WHERE lower(description) LIKE '%enbrel%'
    AND currency = 'USD'
),
per_mg AS (
  SELECT
    product_type,
    cost / CASE
             WHEN product_type = '25 mg kit' THEN 25.0
             WHEN product_type = '50 mg/mL SureClick syringe' THEN 50.0
           END AS cost_per_mg
  FROM enbrel_prices
  WHERE product_type IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  product_type,
  COUNT(*) AS n_prices,
  ROUND(AVG(cost_per_mg), 4) AS avg_cost_per_mg,
  ROUND(MIN(cost_per_mg), 4) AS min_cost_per_mg,
  ROUND(MAX(cost_per_mg), 4) AS max_cost_per_mg
FROM per_mg
GROUP BY product_type
ORDER BY avg_cost_per_mg ASC
LIMIT 50;

WITH ddi AS (
  SELECT
    CASE 
      WHEN drug1 = 'Leuprolide' THEN drug2
      WHEN drug2 = 'Leuprolide' THEN drug1
    END AS concomitant_med,
    interaction
  FROM "drugbank_query_ddi_table"
  WHERE (drug1 = 'Leuprolide' OR drug2 = 'Leuprolide')
    AND (
      LOWER(interaction) LIKE '%qtc%' OR
      LOWER(interaction) LIKE '%qt interval%' OR
      LOWER(interaction) LIKE '%qt prolong%' OR
      LOWER(interaction) LIKE '%qt-prolong%'
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  d.concomitant_med,
  d.interaction,
  f.food_interaction
FROM ddi d
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  ON s.synonym = d.concomitant_med COLLATE NOCASE
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drug_food_interactions" f
  ON f.drugbank_id = s.drugbank_id
WHERE f.food_interaction LIKE 'Avoid %'
LIMIT 50;

       p.name AS pfam_carrier_family_name
FROM (
  SELECT drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_manufacturers"
  WHERE lower(trim(manufacturer)) IN ('sanofi aventis us llc', 'astrazeneca lp')
  GROUP BY drugbank_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lower(trim(manufacturer))) = 2
) AS d
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT name
  FROM "drugbank_carriers_polypeptides_pfams"
  WHERE identifier = 'PF00273'
  LIMIT 1
) AS p
ORDER BY d.drugbank_id
LIMIT 50;

ELANE (neutrophil elastase). Its protein inhibits C5a-induced neutrophil chemotaxis (migration toward C5a).

EC 3.4.21.37 is leukocyte/neutrophil elastase, which in humans is encoded by the ELANE gene (historically ELA2). WITH
lep AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drugbank_id AS dbid
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn"
  WHERE LOWER(synonym) LIKE 'lepirudin%'

  dl.ref_id AS identifier,
  dl.title,
  dl.url
FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" dl
JOIN lep ON dl.parent_key = lep.dbid
WHERE LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%pathway%'
   OR LOWER(dl.url) LIKE '%pathway%'
   OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%smpdb%'

WHERE (LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%fda%' OR LOWER(dl.url) LIKE '%fda%' OR LOWER(dl.title) LIKE '%dailymed%' OR LOWER(dl.url) LIKE '%dailymed%')
